scraped.description:
Position:OPERATIONS & ADMINISTRATIVE COORDINATOR
Industry: Property Maintenance | Home Safety & Compliance Services
Salary range: up to Php 85,000 Philippine Peso/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.)
Working Hours: Monday to Friday following Australian business time
Work set-up: 100% Remote work (Independent Contractor Agreement)
Holidays: TBC
Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and assessment
About the Company & Role
Our client is an Australia-based service and maintenance company providing essential property maintenance, inspection, and compliance-related services to residential and commercial property stakeholders. The business works closely with property managers, customers, and field service professionals to coordinate maintenance requirements, scheduled appointments, and day-to-day service operations. They are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and resourceful Operations & Administrative Coordinator who can provide reliable administrative support while taking ownership of daily job coordination and scheduling activities. This is not a purely administrative or task-based position; the successful candidate must be comfortable making independent decisions, solving operational challenges, and keeping workflows moving with minimal supervision. You will work closely with management and field personnel to ensure jobs are properly scheduled, access arrangements are coordinated, and important operational tasks are followed through. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of a growing Australian business.
Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate daily job schedules, service appointments, and work orders to ensure efficient operations.

- Arrange property access and coordinate appointments with tenants, property managers, customers, and field personnel.

- Monitor job progress, follow up on pending tasks, and ensure scheduled work is completed within expected timelines.

- Manage schedule changes, appointment cancellations, rescheduling requests, and unexpected operational issues.

- Maintain accurate job records, customer information, property details, and administrative documentation.

- Handle email correspondence, phone enquiries, and general business communications professionally.

- Coordinate information and updates between management, office personnel, and field-based teams.

- Use job management software to create, update, monitor, and track service jobs and appointments.

- Identify potential scheduling conflicts, access issues, and workflow bottlenecks, and take appropriate action.

- Provide general administrative and operational support to management as required.

- Recommend practical improvements to existing administrative processes and daily workflows.

Requirements
Essential Qualifications & Experience

- At least 2–3 years of experience in Operations Administration, Service Coordination, Executive Assistance, Administrative Support, or a similar role.

- Previous experience managing job schedules, service bookings, work orders, appointments, or operational workflows.

- Experience using job management software, field service management systems, or similar business platforms.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities.

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with the confidence to work independently.

- Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to anticipate operational needs rather than wait for instructions.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable communicating with different stakeholders, including customers, property managers, and field personnel.

- High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

- Adaptable and quick to learn new software, systems, and business processes.

- Reliable, accountable, and capable of working with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

- Experience using Simpro (a significant advantage).

- Familiarity with similar job management platforms such as ServiceM8, AroFlo, Tradify, Fergus, Ascora, or Jobber.

- Previous experience in property maintenance, facilities management, electrical services, plumbing, construction, or trades-related industries.

- Experience coordinating technicians, contractors, or field service personnel.

- Exposure to Australian property management, real estate, or maintenance operations.

- Previous experience supporting business owners, directors, or senior management.

Required Tools & Software

- 
Job Management Software: Simpro (highly preferred), ServiceM8, AroFlo, Tradify, Fergus, or similar.

- 
Productivity Tools: Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

- 
Communication Tools: Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or similar platforms.

- 
Administrative Tools: Digital calendars, spreadsheets, email management, and documentation systems.

scraped.title: Senior Executive Assistant, Marketing
scraped.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
As a Senior Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll participate in leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders and their teams and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs one to two weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion, moving quickly as priorities shift.
What you’ll do

- Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.

- Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.

- Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.

- Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.

- Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.

- Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects. Partner with senior leaders and their teams, helping team leads succeed.

- Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools, with Claude as our standard, to streamline research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone. Build automations and repeatable workflows to handle high-volume work quickly.

- Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.

- Build warm, proactive relationships across both teams, including timely recognition of milestones and quick, thoughtful gestures such as notes and gifts.

What you’ll bring

- Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-paced, AI-forward company, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.

- An organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities, taking ownership within agreed priorities, and communicating progress proactively, moving quickly, and figuring things out independently with limited resources.

- Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.

- Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.

- Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics. Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating recurring work.

- Clear, warm, approachable, and proactively personable communication across functions and levels, sound judgment with confidential information, and experience building trusted relationships in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central. Ability to navigate multi-stakeholder requests with tact, balancing protection of the leaders’ time with support for key teammates.

- Flexibility to support meetings across time zones occasionally outside standard hours when needed, with approximately quarterly travel for offsites and events.

- Based in the US or Canada with overlap with Pacific Time preferred.

About the team
You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders whose teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change. You’ll be a true member of the team, not just a support function.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

scraped.title: Operations Coordinator aka Multitasking Meerkat
scraped.description:
Summary 
We're looking for a Next Gen Operations Coordinator to support two busy Senior Directors who lead partner Next Generation (Next Gen) teams and help with cross-functional coordination across teams and administrative support. 
You'll provide critical support to the Senior Directors’ daily operating rhythm, prioritize competing demands, track critical deadlines, and remove administrative workload from their portfolios. With no direct reports, you will also be the connective tissue in translating busy team schedules into structured timelines to ensure initiatives move forward with clarity and speed. 
Flexibility to travel and work across different time zones required. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Direct support for two Senior Directors 

- Apply situational awareness to triage and optimize daily schedules within Canopy’s project management tool, ensuring critical tasks are prioritized, and high-urgency items take precedence. 

- Proactively provide deadline reminders, track deliverables, and respond to requests within a delegated scope to maintain a high-velocity communication loop. 

- Provide comprehensive administrative support including calendar management, organization of team meetings, creation of meeting agendas, reimbursement requests, and general operational logistics. 

- Report to the Impact Operations Senior Coordinator and exercise judgement to keep your work aligned with wider Impact team objectives and timelines, while supporting both Senior Directors’ day to day. 

2. Cross-Functional Coordination and Communication 

- Be the connective tissue for the Next Gen teams and other teams (larger Impact, Operations, People and Culture teams) in the organization. 

- Design, implement, and maintain cross-team systems to seamlessly coordinate conferences and event participation, cross-team collaboration, and engagement with external parties. 

- Own and develop the cadence and facilitation of cross-functional meetings, establishing clear agendas and action steps to optimize participant time and outcomes. 

- Lead the logistics, planning, and execution of in-person team summits and collaborative workshops. 

- Drive end-to-end organization of professional development workshops, team deep dives, and specialized staff training programs. 

3. Growth Opportunities 

- Identify, propose, and take ownership of special projects and team support. 

- Participate in Impact efforts by providing project management and other support. 

- Attend and represent Canopy at select events. 

- Drive the follow-through and organizational clarity that lets the Senior Directors operate at their highest level. 

- Ensure the Next Generation teams have strong visibility into priorities and progress to function as a cohesive unit. 

Qualifications and Experience 

- Three to five years in executive assistant, operations coordinator, or leadership support roles in a complex and fast-paced environment. 

- Comfortable in a remote-work environment; tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools. 

- Experience working in sustainability, forest conservation, supply chains, or mission-driven environments is an asset. 

- Exceptionally organized and dependable. 

- Proactive, resourceful, and solutions oriented. 

- A thoughtful, clear, and influential communicator. 

- Embrace a “Yes, AND...” mindset to foster innovation and collaboration 

- A sense of humour! 

Assets 

- Experience with Asana or similar project management tools. 

- Environmental experience and/or interest. 

How to Apply 
Please submit your resume and a cover letter which includes a separate response to the prompt below. Applications missing either the cover letter or the prompt response will not be considered. Please keep your response to 300–400 words. 
Describe a specific situation where you had to support a busy leader navigating competing priorities. Using the STAR method, introduce the situation and challenges. Be sure to detail your internal logic, the frameworks or tools you used to triage the issues and summarize the quantifiable results. 
On AI use and authenticity: You may use AI tools to brainstorm, edit, or proofread, but please do not use AI to write your cover letter. We want to hear your voice, experiences, and perspective. If you use AI for minor editing, add a short note at the end of your cover letter (e.g., "I used [tool name] to proofread this response"). Applications written in a genuine, original voice will be prioritized. 
Canopy is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those underrepresented in the sector. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. All applications are treated in confidence. We thank all applicants; however, we will only contact candidates selected for an interview. 
If you love to optimize operations by proactively supporting directors and busy teams, this role is for you! 
Canopy is a solutions-driven not-for-profit environmental organization dedicated to protecting forests, species, and the climate. For more than 25 years, we've been transforming wood-based supply chains, from publishing and packaging to fashion and textiles, to eliminate fibre from the world's most critical forests and help secure a thriving planet for all.

- Maintain clear communication with the founder and internal stakeholders.

- Required: Previous healthcare industry experience, preferably in healthcare administration, medical billing, or healthcare operations.

- Strong understanding of medical billing workflows, claim submission, and handling rejected claims.

- Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including editing existing templates and creating professional presentations when needed.

- Experience coordinating meetings, preparing materials, and managing follow-up activities.

- Familiarity with Slack, Nextiva, or similar business communication tools is an advantage.

Essential Skills & Qualities

-

Executive Assistant
Programs

Bargaining Unit Position: No
Our Organization 
The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives. 
For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include: 

- Science in the service of people and the planet.  

- Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations.  

- Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.  

- Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.  

- Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.  

- Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.  

The Position 
The Executive Assistant (EA) provides administrative and logistical support for the Executive Director and Programs Division’s senior leadership. This includes scheduling, proactively identifying and resolving schedule conflicts; ensuring materials are prepped and available for meetings; travel support; timely expense and invoice submissions. The EA works with the rest of the Executive support team to implement systems and processes to enable a high-functioning Executive office. They help draft and distribute organization-wide materials, help organize webinars and organization-wide meetings, and take on occasional project management responsibility. They must be able to maintain confidential information with discretion and maturity. They work collaboratively to ensure the effective operations of the Programs Division, center anti-racism and equity, and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment in internal and external interactions. 
Responsibilities 
Full scheduling support for the Executive Director 

- Schedule internal and external meetings and calls in a timely manner 

- Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts 

- Provide timely, well-organized background information for calls and meetings 

 Provide high-quality administrative support for Program Division meetings 

- Call for agenda, coordinating agenda items with Executive Director, VP- Program Impact, Director- Programs, Policy and Advocacy (PPA), and Program Directors’ 

- Take and distribute notes, and send and track follow-up action items 

- Support planning and administrative needs of the Programs Division, including the Program Learning & Impact team and strategic planning needs

Support Program Division events and in-person meetings 

- Make travel arrangements

- Manage and track travel expenses and reimbursements 

- Plan and coordinate logistics for conferences and events, as assigned 

Manage Program Division documents and information flows, and support Research Services 

- Support Knowledge and Research services for the organization, including staff access to subscription resources, management and renewals of subscription resources, training and communications support 

- Support document management for the Programs Division, including timely updates to Nucleus (intranet) 

- Ensure appropriate and timely follow-up on internal and external requests for information or action from Programs Division 

Provide general Executive admin support, as assigned and appropriate 

- Calendar support for the Leadership Team (LT) Workdays and Meetings, especially related to Programs Division engagement (Executive Director, PPA, VP of Program Impact, and Program Directors) 

- Help with Board meetings and in-person logistical support twice a year, as needed 

- Aid in the planning and support of LT workdays and all-staff retreats. 

Requirements
Qualifications and Experience

- Proven ability to support senior-level executives with a high level of attention to detail and careful attention to the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information. 

- Adept at taking initiative, anticipating needs, working independently, and following through on and completing assignments in a timely manner. Able to work effectively as part of a team with a strong problem-solving orientation, with curiosity to understand the full context; proactively learns new tools and proposes solutions 

- Proven time management abilities to meet deadlines with self-motivation and attention to detail. 

- Ability to be responsive in a fast-paced executive environment, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and proactive escalation of urgent or sensitive matters, as needed. 

- Skilled in organizing information and materials for meetings and events, including logistical details. 

- Strong oral and written communication skills with ability to interact with all levels of internal and external constituencies. 

- Demonstrable experience in office and administrative support procedures, and AV support for meetings. 

- Experience in supporting online and in-person meetings, including agenda development, taking notes, timely communication, and logistical planning and support. 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe or other Project Management Tools 

Physical Requirements 

- Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time.  

- Continuously operate a computer and must have the ability to control a mouse and keyboard.   

- Communicate in verbal and written formats with internal staff and external constituents.  

Work Schedule 
Regular office hours, with flexibility to manage East and West Coast time zones, including occasional nights and weekend hours for urgent events or critical deadlines. 
Travel Requirements 
Occasional travel to support in-person Executive and Leadership Team meetings, staff retreats, and Board meetings. 
UCS is an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to diversify its staff. We’re dedicated to broadening opportunities for individuals from demographic groups that are historically underrepresented in the sciences and in environmental advocacy. We’re also committed to building an inclusive workplace culture where talented people of widely diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe the inclusion of culturally diverse perspectives will improve our work and produce better societal and environmental outcomes for all, including historically disenfranchised communities. 
Benefits

Details 
This is a full-time remote position with a preference for Washington, DC. For those who meet all position requirements, the salary is $78,846.86. UCS offers excellent benefits and a rewarding work environment. *CA Resident Only; we offer a 12% salary differential* 
Information about the organization is available at . 
Comparable training and/or experience can be substituted for degrees when appropriate. 
More about the team 
Our team is made up of a dedicated group of researchers, scientists, communicators, campaigners, and advocates from wide-ranging backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and a collaborative and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. We continually strive to create an environment that is a welcoming place for the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, parents, empty-nesters, and people with a wide variety of interests and backgrounds.

Upload materials in Word or PDF format only. No phone calls, please.

The Qualities That Will Help You Succeed

We are a fully remote team of about ten people with historically very little turnover.
About the Role
This is a phone-first role. Email and LinkedIn outreach at Forager is automated and run by our Growth team, so the SDR does the part a machine cannot: get prospects on the phone, qualify them properly, and hand our closers meetings that turn into real opportunities. You will work directly with the CEO, Head of Growth, GTM agency, and our commercial Account Executive (AE). 
Why join

- Sell a product with a real edge: we’re the #1 mobile and personal email provider on Clay 
• Shoulder-to-shoulder training from our current SDR, plus regular coaching using call recordings
• Learn one of the most advanced AI-driven outbound setups in the industry

What you will do

- Respond quickly to inbound leads (demo requests from our website, data requests from marketplaces, and partner and referral introductions). Speed-to-lead is one of your key metrics 
• Run qualification calls with inbound and outbound leads: use case, data need and volume, budget, buying process and timeline. Route each lead to the right closer, or to self-service when that is the better fit.
• Cold call the accounts our signal engine flags each sprint (our Tier 1 and Tier 2 target accounts), and book qualification calls and demos from those conversations.
• Book meetings that closers accept. A demo counts as "Demo Accepted" when the AE has reviewed your call notes and agreed the opportunity is qualified. Demo Accepted is your core metric and drives your variable pay.
• Bring what you learn back to the sprint review with Growth and Sales: which objections come up, which messaging lands, which signals convert.
• Keep HubSpot accurate on every lead you touch. AI drafts the notes, enrichment and follow-ups; you confirm the facts and the next step. 

What you will NOT spend your time on

- Writing and sending email or LinkedIn sequences. These are automated and owned by the Growth team; you see the replies, not the sends.
• Building lists or researching accounts. The signal engine and AI do this before a name reaches your call list.
• Manual CRM data entry, call notes and meeting prep. AI drafts these; you check them.

Tools and systems

- HubSpot: CRM, lead routing, deal stages and the Demo Accepted gate 

• Parallel dialer for outbound calling

- Automated email and LinkedIn software with sequences whose replies land with you
• Call recording software, used for coaching and for AI call notes
• AI assistants for account research, call summaries, CRM updates and follow-up drafts

Requirements
Must-haves:

- Previous experience in a phone-heavy B2B SDR, BDR or inside sales role, ideally 2+ years
• A cold-calling track record you can show: daily dial and connect volumes, meetings booked, and opportunities your sales team accepted that started with your cold call 
• Strong qualification skills: you know how to uncover need, budget and decision process, and you never leave a call without a next step 
• Clear, confident spoken English and comfort with technical buyers (product, data and engineering leaders)
• Comfortable learning technical products quickly; you’ll explain enrichment APIs and data feeds to technical buyers 
• Self-managed and comfortable working in a fully remote team.

Nice-to-haves:

- You have sold B2B data, sales technology, recruiting technology or developer and data infrastructure
• You have experience with a parallel dialer, and HubSpot
• You have worked marketplace or partner-sourced leads

Benefits
• Full-time contractor role

- Fully remote. Any location, with a daily calling window of at least four hours between 9am and 6pm US Eastern.
• Base pay plus variable, split roughly 70/30. Variable is paid on Demo Accepted meetings, not on meetings booked
• Untracked PTO: take the time off you need, with no accrual to count. We trust you to get the job done 

Sound like you? Apply with your CV and a 2-minute audio or video recording about a cold call you made that turned into an opportunity your sales team accepted: what you said, the objection you hit, how you knew it was worth a meeting, and what happened after the handoff . We review every application, and our recruiter will be in touch within a few days to walk you through next steps!

This is a high-trust role supporting senior leadership, with responsibilities expected to include calendar and travel management, coordination with internal and external stakeholders, meeting preparation and follow-up, research, communications, and broader executive support in a fast-paced, high-profile environment.
This is not a traditional admin role focused primarily on ad hoc tasks. We are looking for professionals who are comfortable working directly with executives, managing competing priorities, anticipating needs, protecting confidential information, and taking ownership of tasks and processes from start to finish.
The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, resourceful, and capable of working with minimal supervision. You should be someone who can identify what needs to be done, determine the best way to accomplish it, and follow through without needing constant direction.
Estimated Salary: The salary for this position has not been finalized yet. Please indicate your expected salary based on your experience in the application form, and we will consider it in our discussions.
Responsibilities:
Executive Support

- Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to senior executives.

- Manage complex calendars, schedules, appointments, and competing priorities.

- Coordinate meetings, calls, and virtual appointments across multiple time zones, including Zoom meetings.

- Help executives start each day organized and prepared by reviewing the calendar, highlighting key meetings, and proactively flagging new people, companies, or priorities that may require additional preparation.

- Conduct advanced research on new contacts, companies, meeting participants, and relevant preferences or background information to help executives prepare effectively.

- Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and other executive documents.

- Assist with PowerPoint presentation cleanup, formatting, and basic editing.

- Take meeting notes, track action items, and follow up to ensure commitments are completed.

- Anticipate executives' needs and proactively address issues before they become problems.

- Own administrative processes and projects from initiation through completion.

- Research information, gather options, make recommendations, and present findings clearly.

- Conduct basic company and background research to support meetings, decision-making, and executive preparation.

- Coordinate with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks and ensure deadlines are met.

- Develop and maintain systems, trackers, SOPs, and organizational processes that improve efficiency.

- Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive administrative tasks and improve workflows.

- Exercise sound judgment when determining what requires immediate attention, what can wait, and when an executive needs to be contacted or reminded—particularly when the executive is unavailable.

- Take ownership of resolving routine issues independently and escalate matters appropriately when executive input is genuinely required.

Travel & Logistics

- Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, transportation, and itineraries.

- Prepare detailed travel itineraries and supporting information.

- Assist with business and personal travel planning, including vacation planning, as needed.

- Assist with meeting, event, and off-site logistics.

- Handle last-minute changes and troubleshoot logistical issues as they arise.

- Coordinate travel and logistics approximately 2–3 times per month, with the flexibility to accommodate changing needs.

Communication & Coordination

- Draft and proofread professional emails, documents, presentations, and other correspondence.

- Communicate professionally with executives, clients, partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

- Represent executives professionally when coordinating schedules, meetings, and requests.

- Manage sensitive information and maintain a high level of discretion and confidentiality.

- Use strong written and verbal communication skills to ensure information is communicated clearly and efficiently.

General Executive & Administrative Support

- Assist with special projects and executive-level initiatives.

- Conduct online research and prepare summaries, reports, or recommendations.

- Maintain organized digital files, records, and documentation.

- Support expense management, including receipt collection, tracking, and reconciliation through Ramp or similar expense-management software.

- Support basic reporting and administrative coordination where required.

- Take on other responsibilities that support the effectiveness and productivity of the executive team.

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in executive assistance, virtual assistance, administrative support, operations coordination, or a similar role.

- Previous experience supporting executives, founders, business owners, directors, or senior leaders is strongly preferred.

- Proven experience working as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Executive Administrative Assistant, or similar high-level administrative professional.

- Strong experience managing calendars, schedules, meetings, correspondence, and executive priorities.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

- Strong judgment and the ability to determine what requires immediate attention versus what can wait.

- Highly proactive and resourceful; able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics , companies, and individuals and figuring out solutions independently.

- Strong follow-through and accountability—you don't need to be repeatedly reminded to complete tasks.

- High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Strong proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack, iMessage, project management platforms, and similar tools.

- Comfortable working with international teams and across different time zones.

- Comfortable coordinating domestic and international travel and adapting to changing priorities throughout the day.

The Ideal Candidate
You will thrive in this role if you:

- Think ahead rather than simply react to requests.

- Can take a broad instruction and turn it into a completed outcome.

- Are comfortable saying, "I've already taken care of it."

- Naturally keep track of details, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Can manage several executives' priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.

- Are resourceful and know how to find answers rather than waiting for someone else to provide them.

- Have strong business judgment and know when to act independently and when to escalate.

- Can distinguish between a true priority and something that can reasonably wait.

- Are comfortable making judgment calls when an executive is unavailable and know when something is important enough to interrupt or follow up.

- Are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and changing priorities.

- Take ownership of your work and treat the executive's time as highly valuable.

- Are dependable, discreet, polished, and professional in all interactions.

- Naturally prepare ahead of meetings by understanding who the executive is meeting, why the meeting matters, and what background may be useful.

Qualifications That Are a Plus

- Experience supporting C-suite executives, founders, entrepreneurs, or senior leadership.

- Experience working with international clients or companies.

- Experience supporting executives based in the US or other international markets.

- Experience managing multiple executives or stakeholders simultaneously.

- Experience with project management or operations coordination.

- Familiarity with tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, Ramp, or similar platforms.

- Experience creating SOPs, workflows, systems, and process documentation.

- Experience coordinating travel, events, or complex business logistics.

- Experience with presentation preparation and PowerPoint formatting/editing.

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first few months, a successful Executive Administrative Assistant should be able to:

- Become a reliable extension of the executive they support.

- Start each day with a clear understanding of the executive's schedule, priorities, and upcoming needs.

- Manage recurring administrative responsibilities with minimal supervision.

- Keep calendars, meetings, communications, travel, and follow-ups organized.

- Proactively research new people, companies, and meetings so the executive is prepared in advance.

- Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively prepare for them.

- Take ownership of projects and administrative processes rather than simply completing individual tasks.

- Make sound judgment calls about priorities and know when to act independently versus when to escalate.

- Resolve routine issues without unnecessary executive involvement.

- Reduce the executive's administrative workload and allow them to focus more time on strategic priorities.

- Build trust through consistency, discretion, sound judgment, responsiveness, and strong follow-through.

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. About the role
We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.
His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. You’ll take ownership of both: triaging his email, responding where appropriate, routing what needs his attention, and building his scheduling system from scratch.
This is not a task-taker role. He needs someone with strong judgment who can quickly learn who’s who and what matters, decide what’s urgent, and keep things moving without waiting to be told. Your first 30 days will focus on fixing his top three time-killers, and by 90 days you should be running his inbox and calendar with confidence.
This is a part-time, remote position. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion.
Compensation: 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience)
Location: Remote, Philippines
Job Type: Part-time
What you'll do
Email triage and responsiveness (main priority)

- Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it.

- Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice.

- Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval.

- Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

Judgment-based routing

- Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d.

- Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled.

- Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems.

Calendar and scheduling

- Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules.

- Schedule calls and meetings with lenders, lawyers, brokers, contractors and internal staff.

- Protect his time so his calendar reflects his real priorities.

Process and partnership

- Hold regular check-ins with him to review open items, routing decisions and what to adjust.

- Build and maintain a living playbook of routing rules, key contacts and recurring processes.

- Spot recurring time drains and propose practical fixes.

Our hiring process

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself, then a prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

Requirements
Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar executive support role, including experience working with US-based executives or companies.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Confident replying to emails on an executive's behalf, in his voice.

- High discretion with financial, legal and tenant information.

- Available part-time with consistent overlap during US business hours (exact schedule confirmed during the process).

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in real estate, property management, multifamily, acquisitions or development.

- Experience working with lenders, lawyers, insurance claims or accounting teams.

- Familiarity with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi, Buildium).

- Experience setting up inbox rules, labels or automations in Gmail or Outlook.

- Experience writing and maintaining SOPs or playbooks.

scraped.title: VIRTUAL LEGAL EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
scraped.description:
VIRTUAL LEGAL EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week
This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.
VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.
We are looking for a skilled Executive Assistant with direct legal experience who can own the client relationship and provide back-office support to attorneys and law firms. You will keep calendars, case files, and deadlines in order for professionals who spend much of their time in court or on the road, so they can focus on their clients’ matters. Self-motivation and professional discipline are essential, because attorneys will rely on you to protect their time and their clients’ confidentiality. Adaptability matters just as much, since the work changes with each firm, practice area, and system you are asked to use.
Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another’s success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.
Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.
EXPECTATIONS
Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive & Professional Manner

- Demonstrate a strong work ethic and positive attitude with attorneys, their clients, court staff, and outside vendors.

- Ensure all communication reflects VaVa’s standards of professionalism and care.

- Actively contribute to a thriving contractor culture by embracing VaVa’s values.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

- Manage day-to-day account activities reliably, and learn each attorney’s practice, active matters, and working preferences well enough to support them accurately.

- Anticipate client needs and communicate progress consistently so clients always know where deadlines and matters stand.

- Protect attorney-client confidentiality in every task and every tool you use.

- Handle challenges independently without letting quality slip or client confidence waver.

- Track engagement hours and flag early when adjustments are needed to sustain service.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Manage attorney inboxes by prioritizing and filtering messages from clients, courts, and opposing counsel, drafting responses, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Coordinate attorney calendars across time zones for client meetings, consultations, court appearances, hearings, depositions, and mediations, building in travel and buffer time around court days. Handle itineraries and bookings, and adjust quickly when court schedules change.

- Enter and track court deadlines, statutes of limitations, and filing dates in the calendar and case management system, applying court rules as directed and verified by the attorney, with reminders set and conflicts flagged early.

- Support mobile attorneys with daily briefings before court days, shared calendars, a clear routing system for urgent items, and mobile access to files and client portals, so work continues between court and office.

- Open and maintain matters in the case management system or CRM, including client intake, conflict check data entry, engagement letters, and e-signature tracking, and keep records accurate through data entry, deduplication, cleanup, and import and export mapping.

- Draft, format, and proofread legal correspondence, memos, pleadings, motions, and discovery documents for attorney review using firm templates and court formatting rules, then prepare and submit filings through court e-filing portals, confirm acceptance, and file proofs of service.

- Organize and maintain case files, including document naming, version control, redaction, indexing, and retention in the firm’s document management system.

- Conduct legal and factual research using tools such as Westlaw or LexisNexis as directed by the attorney, and summarize findings in research memos for attorney review.

- Support litigation and trial preparation, including discovery tracking, exhibit organization, Bates numbering, deposition summaries, and trial binders.

- Coordinate with court reporters, process servers, interpreters, and expert witnesses, including ordering transcripts and confirming deposition logistics, and provide virtual support during hearings, depositions, and client meetings, including setup, exhibit sharing, and note taking.

- Build and maintain spreadsheets for case, deadline, and expense tracking, including basic analysis for firm reports.

- Provide light billing support, including time entry, expense coding, and invoice preparation for attorney review, without taking on bookkeeping or trust accounting.

- Use AI tools to summarize documents, draft first-pass correspondence, and organize research, with attorney review of all output, and set up automations for reminders, intake, and follow-ups where appropriate.

- Handle privileged, personal, and financial information with strict discretion, follow each client’s data security requirements, and never enter client data into unapproved AI tools.

- Provide administrative support only, and refer any question that calls for legal judgment or advice to the attorney.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.

- At least 3 years of demonstrated experience in an executive or administrative support role, including direct support to at least one executive.

- At least 1 year of direct experience working with a practicing attorney, firm, or legal team.

- At least 1 year of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity.

- Solid understanding of legal terminology and processes, including litigation, depositions, legal research, and the drafting and filing of legal documents.

- Demonstrated ability to adapt legal administrative skills across practice areas, firm types, and client systems.

- Available at least 20 hours per week to support high-touch (daily), deliverable-focused clients.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
Must Have

- Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including formatting legal documents to court or firm style and producing polished presentations and spreadsheets without client oversight.

- Daily use of Slack and Zoom, including setup for virtual hearings, depositions, and meetings, and basic troubleshooting.

- Experience with at least one case management system or CRM, such as Clio, MyCase, Salesforce, or HubSpot, including matter setup, data entry, and record maintenance.

- Experience with at least one project management platform such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, or Monday.com.

- Experience with legal calendaring, including court deadlines, hearing dates, and reminders, and with a scheduling tool such as Calendly or Acuity (or a case management system’s booking feature) for consultations and intake.

- Experience supporting litigation and case preparation, including court filings through e-filing portals, case file and document management, discovery tracking, deposition scheduling, and exhibit or trial binder preparation.

- Experience with legal research tools such as Westlaw or LexisNexis.

- Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume inboxes, complex calendars, and travel remotely, including for attorneys who are frequently away from the office.

- Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including imports, exports, and basic data analysis.

- General AI literacy and comfort using AI tools to draft content and streamline routine tasks, with an understanding of what privileged and client data should never be entered into AI systems.

Preferred

- Paralegal certification or paralegal experience.

- Experience with document management systems such as iManage or NetDocuments.

- Experience with e-signature tools such as DocuSign or PandaDoc, secure client portals, and document redaction tools.

- Experience with time entry, expense coding, and invoice preparation in Clio, MyCase, or similar systems.

- Experience supporting virtual depositions and hearings, including coordination with court reporters and other legal vendors.

- Experience with workflow automation tools such as Zapier or case management automations, and with AI-assisted workflows for document summarization, research organization, or intake.

EDUCATION
A degree is not required. Demonstrated competency and consistent professional growth carry more weight than a credential alone. Candidates without a degree should hold at least one relevant certification, such as a paralegal certificate, NALA Certified Paralegal credential, NALS Accredited Legal Professional or Professional Legal Secretary credential, Clio certification, administrative professional certification, or equivalent. A paralegal certification is preferred for all candidates. A commitment to continued learning is an expectation of this role.

Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases. Pulmovant’s first investigational candidate, mosliciguat, is designed to provide a novel, once-daily, inhaled treatment option for patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Mosliciguat is a potential first-in-class soluble guanylate cyclase activator with a differentiated mechanism of action currently being evaluated in the Phase 3 PHrontier global clinical trial in PH-ILD, but with potential broad applicability across the PH and ILD disease landscape. 

Pulmovant recently announced positive results from its Phase 2 PHocus study evaluating mosliciguat for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), a progressive and life-threatening condition with significant unmet medical needs for patients. PHocus met both primary and secondary endpoints including the highest ever reported pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction in any randomized controlled PH trial. The robust results, in conjunction with mosliciguat’s once-daily, inhaled administration and potential first-in-class sGC activator profile, strongly position it as a potential single agent treatment and combination therapy for patients with PH-ILD.  These data represent a significant advancement in a devastating disease that affects ~200,000 patients with no or very limited treatment options. A Phase 3 trial is currently underway. More details can be found in the press release here.

scraped.title: Senior Executive Assistant, Marketing
scraped.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
As a Senior Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll participate in leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders and their teams and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs one to two weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion, moving quickly as priorities shift.
What you’ll do

- Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.

- Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.

- Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.

- Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.

- Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.

- Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects. Partner with senior leaders and their teams, helping team leads succeed.

- Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools, with Claude as our standard, to streamline research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone. Build automations and repeatable workflows to handle high-volume work quickly.

- Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.

- Build warm, proactive relationships across both teams, including timely recognition of milestones and quick, thoughtful gestures such as notes and gifts.

What you’ll bring

- Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-paced, AI-forward company, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.

- An organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities, taking ownership within agreed priorities, and communicating progress proactively, moving quickly, and figuring things out independently with limited resources.

- Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.

- Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.

- Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics. Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating recurring work.

- Clear, warm, approachable, and proactively personable communication across functions and levels, sound judgment with confidential information, and experience building trusted relationships in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central. Ability to navigate multi-stakeholder requests with tact, balancing protection of the leaders’ time with support for key teammates.

- Flexibility to support meetings across time zones occasionally outside standard hours when needed, with approximately quarterly travel for offsites and events.

- Based in the US or Canada with overlap with Pacific Time preferred.

About the team
You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders whose teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change. You’ll be a true member of the team, not just a support function.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$95,200—$160,800 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund

- Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. scraped.title: Operations Coordinator aka Multitasking Meerkat
scraped.description:
Summary 
We're looking for a Next Gen Operations Coordinator to support two busy Senior Directors who lead partner Next Generation (Next Gen) teams and help with cross-functional coordination across teams and administrative support. 
You'll provide critical support to the Senior Directors’ daily operating rhythm, prioritize competing demands, track critical deadlines, and remove administrative workload from their portfolios. With no direct reports, you will also be the connective tissue in translating busy team schedules into structured timelines to ensure initiatives move forward with clarity and speed. 
Flexibility to travel and work across different time zones required. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Direct support for two Senior Directors 

- Apply situational awareness to triage and optimize daily schedules within Canopy’s project management tool, ensuring critical tasks are prioritized, and high-urgency items take precedence. 

- Proactively provide deadline reminders, track deliverables, and respond to requests within a delegated scope to maintain a high-velocity communication loop. 

- Provide comprehensive administrative support including calendar management, organization of team meetings, creation of meeting agendas, reimbursement requests, and general operational logistics. 

- Report to the Impact Operations Senior Coordinator and exercise judgement to keep your work aligned with wider Impact team objectives and timelines, while supporting both Senior Directors’ day to day. 

2. Cross-Functional Coordination and Communication 

- Be the connective tissue for the Next Gen teams and other teams (larger Impact, Operations, People and Culture teams) in the organization. 

- Design, implement, and maintain cross-team systems to seamlessly coordinate conferences and event participation, cross-team collaboration, and engagement with external parties. 

- Own and develop the cadence and facilitation of cross-functional meetings, establishing clear agendas and action steps to optimize participant time and outcomes. 

- Lead the logistics, planning, and execution of in-person team summits and collaborative workshops. 

- Drive end-to-end organization of professional development workshops, team deep dives, and specialized staff training programs. 

3. Growth Opportunities 

- Identify, propose, and take ownership of special projects and team support. 

- Participate in Impact efforts by providing project management and other support. 

- Attend and represent Canopy at select events. 

- Drive the follow-through and organizational clarity that lets the Senior Directors operate at their highest level. 

- Ensure the Next Generation teams have strong visibility into priorities and progress to function as a cohesive unit. 

Qualifications and Experience 

- Three to five years in executive assistant, operations coordinator, or leadership support roles in a complex and fast-paced environment. 

- Comfortable in a remote-work environment; tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools. 

- Experience working in sustainability, forest conservation, supply chains, or mission-driven environments is an asset. 

- Exceptionally organized and dependable. 

- Proactive, resourceful, and solutions oriented. 

- A thoughtful, clear, and influential communicator. 

- Embrace a “Yes, AND...” mindset to foster innovation and collaboration 

- A sense of humour! 

Assets 

- Experience with Asana or similar project management tools. 

- Environmental experience and/or interest. 

How to Apply 
Please submit your resume and a cover letter which includes a separate response to the prompt below. Applications missing either the cover letter or the prompt response will not be considered. Please keep your response to 300–400 words. 
Describe a specific situation where you had to support a busy leader navigating competing priorities. Using the STAR method, introduce the situation and challenges. Be sure to detail your internal logic, the frameworks or tools you used to triage the issues and summarize the quantifiable results. 
On AI use and authenticity: You may use AI tools to brainstorm, edit, or proofread, but please do not use AI to write your cover letter. We want to hear your voice, experiences, and perspective. If you use AI for minor editing, add a short note at the end of your cover letter (e.g., "I used [tool name] to proofread this response"). Applications written in a genuine, original voice will be prioritized. 
Canopy is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those underrepresented in the sector. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. All applications are treated in confidence. We thank all applicants; however, we will only contact candidates selected for an interview. 
If you love to optimize operations by proactively supporting directors and busy teams, this role is for you! 
Canopy is a solutions-driven not-for-profit environmental organization dedicated to protecting forests, species, and the climate. For more than 25 years, we've been transforming wood-based supply chains, from publishing and packaging to fashion and textiles, to eliminate fibre from the world's most critical forests and help secure a thriving planet for all.

Through technology-driven healthcare solutions, personalized support, and community-based programs, the organization helps mothers access essential healthcare services and resources.
The organization works with healthcare professionals, health plans, and community partners to make maternal healthcare more accessible, inclusive, and effective.
They are seeking a highly independent, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant with hands-on Tebra medical billing experience to support billing operations, executive administration, and sales coordination.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can take ownership of responsibilities, solve problems independently, and consistently deliver results without requiring close supervision.
This is a long-term remote opportunity with the potential to grow into a full-time role.
Key Responsibilities
1. Medical Billing & Tebra Management (Immediate Priority)

- Take ownership of outstanding medical billing tasks and help clear the existing billing backlog.

- Submit and process medical claims accurately using Tebra.

- Review billing information for accuracy and completeness before claim submission.

- Monitor claim statuses, identify potential billing issues, and troubleshoot rejected claims when they occur.

- Coordinate billing activities between the organization's internal EHR platform and Tebra.

- Maintain accurate billing records and track outstanding items through resolution.

- Manage ongoing billing activities, initially estimated at approximately 10–20 items per month, with workload potentially increasing as the organization grows.

- Ensure claims are processed promptly and billing tasks do not accumulate.

2. Executive Assistance & Sales Coordination (Core Responsibility)

- Provide direct administrative and executive support to the founder.

- Coordinate and schedule sales meetings with prospective clients, partners, and stakeholders.

- Prepare meeting agendas, documents, and presentation materials for sales calls.

- Create, edit, and update professional PowerPoint presentations using existing templates, with the ability to develop new presentations when needed.

- Manage post-meeting follow-ups and track action items.

- Follow established follow-up schedules, including 3-day and 7-day follow-ups, without repeated reminders.

- Coordinate internal team meetings and maintain organized schedules.

- Support the founder with administrative tasks to improve overall productivity and workflow efficiency.

3. Independent Task Management & Critical Thinking (Essential)

- Work autonomously with minimal supervision and take full ownership of assigned responsibilities.

- Proactively identify outstanding tasks, anticipate needs, and take action without waiting for instructions.

- Follow documented SOPs, workflows, and templates while exercising sound judgment when unexpected situations arise.

Our Organization 
The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives. 
For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include: 

- Science in the service of people and the planet.  

- Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations.  

- Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.  

- Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.  

- Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.  

- Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.  

The Position 
The Executive Assistant (EA) provides administrative and logistical support for the Executive Director and Programs Division’s senior leadership. This includes scheduling, proactively identifying and resolving schedule conflicts; ensuring materials are prepped and available for meetings; travel support; timely expense and invoice submissions. The EA works with the rest of the Executive support team to implement systems and processes to enable a high-functioning Executive office. They help draft and distribute organization-wide materials, help organize webinars and organization-wide meetings, and take on occasional project management responsibility. They must be able to maintain confidential information with discretion and maturity. They work collaboratively to ensure the effective operations of the Programs Division, center anti-racism and equity, and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment in internal and external interactions. 
Responsibilities 
Full scheduling support for the Executive Director

 Provide high-quality administrative support for Program Division meetings
