- Manage, coordinate, and track progress on tasks for working groups and meetings, as assigned 

Support Program Division events and in-person meetings 

- Make travel arrangements 

- Book flights, hotels, and ground transportation for Executive Director and meeting participants, as needed 

- Manage and track travel expenses and reimbursements 

- Plan and coordinate logistics for conferences and events, as assigned 

Manage Program Division documents and information flows, and support Research Services 

- Support Knowledge and Research services for the organization, including staff access to subscription resources, management and renewals of subscription resources, training and communications support 

- Support document management for the Programs Division, including timely updates to Nucleus (intranet) 

- Ensure appropriate and timely follow-up on internal and external requests for information or action from Programs Division 

Provide general Executive admin support, as assigned and appropriate 

- Calendar support for the Leadership Team (LT) Workdays and Meetings, especially related to Programs Division engagement (Executive Director, PPA, VP of Program Impact, and Program Directors) 

- Help with Board meetings and in-person logistical support twice a year, as needed 

- Aid in the planning and support of LT workdays and all-staff retreats. 

Requirements
Qualifications and Experience

- Proven ability to support senior-level executives with a high level of attention to detail and careful attention to the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information. 

- Adept at taking initiative, anticipating needs, working independently, and following through on and completing assignments in a timely manner. Able to work effectively as part of a team with a strong problem-solving orientation, with curiosity to understand the full context; proactively learns new tools and proposes solutions 

- Proven time management abilities to meet deadlines with self-motivation and attention to detail. 

- Ability to be responsive in a fast-paced executive environment, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and proactive escalation of urgent or sensitive matters, as needed. 

- Skilled in organizing information and materials for meetings and events, including logistical details. 

- Strong oral and written communication skills with ability to interact with all levels of internal and external constituencies. 

- Demonstrable experience in office and administrative support procedures, and AV support for meetings. 

- Experience in supporting online and in-person meetings, including agenda development, taking notes, timely communication, and logistical planning and support. 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe or other Project Management Tools 

Physical Requirements 

- Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time.  

- Continuously operate a computer and must have the ability to control a mouse and keyboard.   

- Communicate in verbal and written formats with internal staff and external constituents.  

Work Schedule 
Regular office hours, with flexibility to manage East and West Coast time zones, including occasional nights and weekend hours for urgent events or critical deadlines. 
Travel Requirements 
Occasional travel to support in-person Executive and Leadership Team meetings, staff retreats, and Board meetings. 
UCS is an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to diversify its staff. We’re dedicated to broadening opportunities for individuals from demographic groups that are historically underrepresented in the sciences and in environmental advocacy. We’re also committed to building an inclusive workplace culture where talented people of widely diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe the inclusion of culturally diverse perspectives will improve our work and produce better societal and environmental outcomes for all, including historically disenfranchised communities. 
Benefits

Details 
This is a full-time remote position with a preference for Washington, DC. For those who meet all position requirements, the salary is $78,846.86. UCS offers excellent benefits and a rewarding work environment. *CA Resident Only; we offer a 12% salary differential*

Our team is made up of a dedicated group of researchers, scientists, communicators, campaigners, and advocates from wide-ranging backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and a collaborative and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. We continually strive to create an environment that is a welcoming place for the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, parents, empty-nesters, and people with a wide variety of interests and backgrounds.

scraped.title: Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support
scraped.description:
ROLE TITLE
Real Estate Executive VA - Administrative Operations & CRM Support
Ready to be the person who keeps three busy real estate partners organized, their leads moving, and their business running smoothly behind the scenes?
We're looking for a sharp, proactive, and experienced Real Estate Executive VA who can take ownership of administrative operations, manage Compass CRM, and ensure important opportunities don't get lost in the day-to-day workload.
If you know your way around Compass, can manage multiple moving pieces without constant reminders, and take pride in keeping every lead, follow-up, document, and task accounted for, this could be your next role.
Pro tip: Applications that include a short introduction video highlighting your real estate experience and hands-on Compass CRM background are strongly encouraged. Be prepared to demonstrate your actual Compass knowledge during the selection process.
This is a fully remote role supporting a U.S.-based residential real estate team. You'll communicate professionally with three managing partners and coordinate closely with their existing ISA and Transaction Coordinator during the client's designated U.S. business hours.
This is not an entry-level real estate VA position. STK will provide orientation on its internal processes and team procedures, but will not provide foundational Compass training. You must have actual, hands-on experience using Compass CRM and be able to work with it confidently from the start. Candidates without this experience should not apply.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Executive and Administrative Support

- When emails and correspondence arrive for the three managing partners, review, organize, prioritize, and flag items requiring their attention.

- Draft routine client and business communications for review or coordination, using the team's established communication practices.

- When appointments, meetings, or scheduling requests arise, coordinate calendars and communicate scheduling details to the appropriate people.

- Track pending administrative assignments, identify approaching deadlines, and follow up before outstanding items become overdue.

- Maintain organized records, business documents, and operational information so the partners can retrieve what they need without searching through scattered communications.

- When routine administrative needs arise, identify the next action and handle it within your authority instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.

- Escalate matters requiring a managing partner's judgment rather than making unauthorized client, business, or transaction decisions.

2. Compass CRM Management and Administration

- Independently navigate and operate Compass CRM and the associated Compass platforms used by the team.

- When new contacts, prospects, or leads enter the business, create or update the appropriate CRM records and maintain accurate contact information.

- Monitor leads generated through website inquiries, QR codes, property signage, and other sources.

- When a lead enters the CRM, review its available information, maintain the appropriate record, and ensure the required follow-up activity is documented.

- Create and manage CRM tasks, reminders, activities, and follow-up records according to established workflows.

- Maintain contact notes and communication histories so the managing partners can understand previous interactions and outstanding next steps.

- Set up buyer property searches and appropriate notifications using the team's established Compass workflows.

- Support the team's existing CRM processes and ensure that leads, contact records, and follow-up activities are not left incomplete.

- Review assigned CRM records for missing information, outdated details, and outstanding activities, and correct issues within your authority.

Mandatory execution standard: You must already know how to use Compass CRM in a real estate operating environment. General CRM experience, familiarity with other real estate platforms, or willingness to learn Compass does not meet this requirement.
3. Lead Management and Follow-Up Coordination

- Monitor incoming buyer and seller inquiries and ensure they are recorded and directed to the appropriate real estate partner.

- Organize prospects according to their current status, interaction history, and required follow-up.

- When prospects are not immediately ready to transact, maintain their follow-up schedules and coordinate longer-term nurturing activities.

- Assist with approved email outreach and client communications.

- Maintain follow-up schedules for networking contacts, referrals, and prospective clients.

- When a prospect requires partner involvement, communicate the relevant context and next action rather than simply forwarding an unorganized contact record.

- Track assigned follow-up activities and identify overdue or missed engagements before they become neglected leads.

- Maintain consistent engagement throughout the sales pipeline using the team's approved processes.

This role requires active follow-through. Updating a CRM record without ensuring that its required next action is accounted for is not sufficient.
4. Inside Sales Agent (ISA) Support

- When the ISA requires prospecting information, research and compile relevant contact lists for the team's existing lead-generation activities.

- Prepare organized prospect lists covering potential sellers, distressed properties, builders, attorneys, and other relevant real estate contacts.

- Maintain accurate prospect information and corresponding lead records in Compass CRM.

- Coordinate prospect list delivery, corrections, and updates with the existing ISA.

- Track administrative aspects of lead-generation activities and maintain the information needed for reporting.

Scope clarification: You are supporting the ISA's administrative and prospecting requirements. You are not replacing the team's existing cold-calling function.
5. Real Estate Listing and Buyer Support

- When new property listings need administrative preparation, enter and update listing information using the team's approved systems.

- Organize property details, listing information, and supporting documentation.

- Maintain listing records and make administrative updates as required.

- When a prospective buyer needs property options, set up and maintain the appropriate buyer searches in Compass.

- Prepare real estate forms, contracts, and related documentation using approved templates and under the appropriate supervision.

- Coordinate required information and document handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.

- Monitor administrative requirements associated with new listings and buyer inquiries, and follow up on missing information or incomplete handoffs.

- Keep administrative records organized so that listing and buyer-related work can progress without avoidable documentation delays.

6. Email Marketing and Client Nurturing

- Assist with creating, scheduling, and managing email marketing campaigns.

- Build and maintain email nurturing sequences using Flodesk and other approved platforms.

- Organize client and prospect lists for targeted communications.

- Support email blasts, action plans, and recurring client engagement campaigns.

- Execute approved marketing workflows and configure practical automation for repetitive communications where applicable.

- Coordinate campaign content and scheduling with the team.

- Maintain accurate audience lists and follow the team's approved campaign instructions.

7. Process Execution and Workflow Improvement

- Follow the team's established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) when completing recurring administrative and operational activities.

- Execute documented workflows consistently rather than creating individual workarounds that bypass established procedures.

- When repetitive administrative work creates unnecessary manual effort, identify the activity and suggest practical opportunities for automation or process improvement.

- Use approved AI-assisted tools, including Claude where applicable, to improve administrative efficiency.

- Maintain operational checklists and tracking systems used to monitor recurring responsibilities.

- Coordinate with Scale Virtually's Process Engineering Team when process updates or workflow adjustments are required.

- Communicate workflow issues when existing instructions are incomplete, conflicting, or preventing accurate execution.

8. Reporting and Accountability

- Submit structured Start-of-Day (SOD) and End-of-Day (EOD) reports.

- At the start of the workday, communicate priorities and identify outstanding items requiring attention.

- At the end of the workday, report completed activities, pending tasks, and outstanding follow-ups.

- Maintain visibility into CRM updates, lead management activities, and important administrative responsibilities.

- Track assigned work through completion and communicate potential delays before deadlines are affected.

- Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate managing partner promptly.

- Keep communication clear and specific so the partners can identify what has been completed, what remains outstanding, and where their involvement is needed.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Candidates must meet ALL of the following:

- Hands-on Compass experience: Previous direct experience using Compass's real estate platforms, particularly Compass CRM, in an actual real estate working environment. Experience with other CRMs alone does not qualify.

- Immediate Compass readiness: Able to independently perform relevant Compass CRM activities without foundational platform training.

- Relevant real estate experience: Previous work as a Real Estate Virtual Assistant, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Real Estate Administrative Assistant.

- Residential real estate knowledge: Understands residential real estate terminology and administrative workflows, including buyer inquiries, seller prospects, property listings, and transaction-related documentation.

- CRM and lead management: Has personally maintained CRM records, organized leads, documented interactions, and coordinated follow-up activities.

- Listing and buyer administration: Has experience supporting property listing administration and buyer-related workflows.

- Executive support capability: Can support multiple executives while keeping priorities, communications, and task ownership organized.

- Independent execution: Can complete established administrative workflows without daily instructions, constant checking, or repeated reminders.

- Professional English communication: Can communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English with managing partners, prospects, the ISA, and the Transaction Coordinator.

- Recordkeeping accuracy: Maintains accurate contact records, notes, documents, follow-up tasks, and operational information.

- SOP compliance: Can follow documented processes and identify when clarification or escalation is necessary.

- Professional judgment: Can handle sensitive client information discreetly and recognize when a matter requires partner approval.

Important: Candidates who have never used Compass CRM hands-on will not proceed, regardless of their general real estate VA experience.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting a multi-agent residential real estate team.

- Experience using Flodesk or similar email marketing platforms.

- Familiarity with Claude or other AI-assisted productivity tools.

- Experience with lead nurturing campaigns and CRM automation.

- Previous coordination with Inside Sales Agents and Transaction Coordinators.

- Familiarity with buyer searches, MLS-related workflows, and listing administration.

- Experience working within structured, process-driven real estate organizations.

TOOLS
Required proficiency:

- Compass CRM

- Associated Compass real estate platforms used by the team

Additional platforms and tools:

- Flodesk

- Claude

- Other approved AI-assisted productivity tools

- Other approved email marketing and administrative platforms

Candidates must distinguish between tools they have actually used and tools they have only encountered or studied.
WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

- You can use Compass without being taught the basics. You have performed real CRM work and can explain exactly how you managed contacts, leads, activities, and buyer searches.

- You close administrative loops. When a lead needs follow-up, a document is missing, or an appointment needs coordination, you track it until the next required action is completed or properly escalated.

- You can manage three partners without creating three times the supervision. You organize competing priorities and make routine decisions within your authority.

- Your CRM records are reliable. The partners and ISA can look at a record and understand the prospect's history, current status, and next action.

- You communicate problems before they become operational failures. You do not wait until a missed deadline or neglected lead becomes someone else's emergency.

- You execute consistently and improve intelligently. You follow SOPs, maintain reporting discipline, and identify practical opportunities to reduce repetitive work.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- This is not a general virtual assistant position for someone whose only experience is calendar management, inbox management, or basic data entry.

- This is not a Compass training opportunity. Candidates who need someone to teach them how Compass CRM works are not qualified.

- This is not an Inside Sales Agent or cold-calling position. The team already has an ISA.

- This is not a Transaction Coordinator position. You will support listing and buyer administration and coordinate documentation handoffs with the existing Transaction Coordinator.

- This is not a passive administrative role. You are expected to own assigned workflows, monitor outstanding tasks, and follow through without constant supervision.

POSITION DETAILS

- 
Work Arrangement: Fully remote.

- 
Employment Structure: Virtual Assistant / independent contractor engagement.

- 
Preferred Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- 
Alternative Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week, may be considered.

- 
Working Hours: Must be available during STK's designated U.S. business hours. The applicable U.S. time zone and agreed schedule will be confirmed during engagement.

- 
Weekend Availability: May be requested depending on operational requirements and the mutually agreed schedule.

- 
Work Environment: Performance-driven, remote, and process-oriented. The role requires consistent communication, structured reporting, independent task ownership, and coordination across multiple team members.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
Applications must demonstrate actual, hands-on Compass experience.
Please submit:

- Your updated resume, including the real estate teams or professionals you have supported and the administrative responsibilities you personally handled.

- A description of your direct experience with Compass CRM. Specify how you used it to manage contacts, incoming leads, follow-up tasks, buyer searches, and listing administration.

- The approximate duration and context of your Compass experience. State whether you used Compass directly in a professional role or only encountered it through training or demonstrations.

- Your experience supporting multiple real estate agents, partners, or executives.

- Your experience with Flodesk, email nurturing, lead management, and coordination with ISAs or Transaction Coordinators.

- Your availability for 20 or 40 hours per week and your ability to work during the client's designated U.S. business hours.

Compass proficiency will be validated during recruitment through a practical assessment using a permitted demonstration environment or a scenario-based walkthrough. Candidates must be able to explain their actual platform experience. STK will not provide foundational Compass software training.
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
Success in this role will be evaluated through observable execution:

- 
Immediate Compass readiness: Performs assigned Compass-related activities independently without basic platform instruction.

- 
Administrative efficiency: Reliably assumes recurring administrative responsibilities from all three managing partners.

- 
CRM accuracy: Maintains complete, accurate, and organized contact and prospect records.

- 
Lead follow-up consistency: Ensures assigned leads have documented follow-up activities and appropriate next steps.

- 
Operational reliability: Completes assigned work on schedule and escalates issues before they affect operations.

- 
Communication: Coordinates effectively with the managing partners, ISA, and Transaction Coordinator.

- 
Process compliance: Follows established workflows, documentation standards, and reporting requirements.

POSITION OBJECTIVE
Provide STK's three managing partners with a dependable, experienced, Compass-proficient Real Estate Executive VA who can immediately take ownership of recurring administrative operations, maintain reliable CRM records, coordinate lead management, and support listing and buyer administration.
The intended result is fewer administrative interruptions for the partners, more consistent prospect follow-up, reliable operational records, and stronger execution across the team's existing real estate workflows.
Benefits

- Paid Time Off

- HMO

- Fully Remote Work

His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.
His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. Email triage and responsiveness (main priority)

If you’re a high-performing admin or legal support professional who is detail-obsessed, speaks up with confidence, and is eager to learn a new industry on the job — and you want to work with a well-established Australian migration agency that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading. 
This isn’t a role for a “quiet task-taker” who waits to be told what to do next. 
This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll take the administrative load off a team of Registered Migration Agents, so every visa application is lodged complete, accurate and on time. 
Why This Is a Dream Job
You’ll be working directly with the migration team of an established Australian immigration agency who: 

- 
Trains You Properly: Teaches its systems and visa workflows through hands-on, collaborative training alongside experienced migration agents and case managers. You don’t need prior immigration experience. 

- 
Values Your Growth: Gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM), monthly scorecards and quarterly reviews, plus a planned rate review at six months based on your performance. 

- 
Respects Your Voice: Wants you to share your thinking, raise risks early and suggest better ways of working, including practical uses of AI tools. 

- 
Builds Stability: Offers a long-term, ongoing role (not project-based), with room to grow as the team scales, including helping onboard future teammates. 

- 
Gives You Daily Support Early On: Holds daily touchpoints with the Operations Leader in your first weeks before moving to a weekly check-in. 

You’ll get career transformation, real exposure to the Australian immigration field, and the chance to grow from guided support to trusted case owner, without being stuck doing data entry with no path forward. 
What You’ll Be Owning
This is a core operations support role covering application preparation, case management and client communication. You aren’t just filing documents; you’re the person who knows where every assigned case stands, catches gaps before an agent does, and keeps clients informed, while leaving all immigration advice and decisions to the authorised agents. 
You’ll take the lead on: 

- 
Application Package Preparation: Preparing and pre-checking visa application packages in Migration Manager against the agent’s checklist, so every package is complete and ready for agent review before the internal deadline. 

- 
Case Control: Updating every case in Migration Manager and Microsoft Planner after each action, and making sure no case stalls without a logged next step. 

- 
Deadline & Visa Expiry Tracking: Owning visa expiry reminders and lodgement deadlines across your caseload, with zero misses. 

- 
Document & Payment Follow-ups: Chasing outstanding documents, information and payments without prompting, and keeping invoicing and service agreements current in Xero. 

- 
Inbox & Client Communication: Managing the shared inbox and calls, answering client, agency and embassy emails on time, actioning urgent requests the same day, and escalating advice-related questions to the supervising agent. 

- 
Drafting & Research: Drafting routine correspondence and supporting statements under agent supervision, and researching legislation and policy updates as directed. 

- 
Process Improvement: Finding and implementing better templates, checklists, AI-assisted drafting and workflow changes that cut repetitive manual work for the team. 

Requirements
This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

- 
Have Admin or Legal Support Experience: You’ve worked in paralegal, legal support or administrative support roles. This is an entry-level role suited to someone ready to be trained. 

- 
Already Know Outlook and Excel: You use both confidently from day one without basic training. Migration Manager, Planner and Xero will be taught. 

- 
Catch What Others Miss: You spot gaps and errors in documents and treat 100% accuracy as the standard, not a stretch goal. 

- 
Juggle Deadlines Calmly: You keep many cases moving at once and prioritise without losing track. 

- 
Speak Up and Take Initiative: You ask questions early, share your progress, and act without being asked. 

- 
Know the Line: You understand that administration and immigration advice are different, and you escalate anything advice-related to the supervising agent. 

- 
Handle Information with Discretion: You treat sensitive client details with strict confidentiality. 

- 
Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins. 

- 
Communicate with Confidence: You write and speak clear, professional English with clients, agencies, embassies and the team. 

- 
Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re comfortable working remotely on Australian business hours, Monday to Friday. 

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Exposure to immigration law or Australian Department of Home Affairs processes; Xero or Migration Manager experience; using AI tools in everyday work. 
What Success Looks Like
After 60–90 Days:

- 
Training Signed Off: You’ve completed on-the-job training in Migration Manager, Planner, Xero and core visa workflows, and work independently on routine tasks. 

- 
Cases Keep Moving: Every assigned case is current in Migration Manager and Planner, follow-ups are tracked, and no case stalls without a next step. 

- 
Deadlines Are Never Missed: Visa expiry reminders and deadlines go out on schedule, and risks are flagged before they become urgent. 

- 
Clients Are Well Informed: The inbox is answered on time, urgent requests are handled the same day, and advice questions reach the right agent. 

- 
Trust Is Earned: You’ve proposed at least one concrete process improvement, and the agents rely on you to run routine case work with light supervision. 

Final Word
If you’ve ever thought: 
“I’m organised, detail-focused and ready to grow. I just want a team that will train me properly, listen to my ideas and give me real ownership.” This is that role. 
Let’s build long-term success — together.

- Comfort working with maps, property records, equipment information, and detailed instructions.

- Ability to quickly learn specific systems and procedures.

- Previous experience supporting teams that manage multiple work orders or service-related tasks.

scraped.title: Bookkeeper & Finance Admin - Malaysia
scraped.location: Remote (Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Vietnam)
scraped.description:
About the role
Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.
This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.
You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.
Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.
The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.
What you'll be doing
Finance & Bookkeeping

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities

- Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments

- Process and record business expenses

- Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors

- Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities

- Produce a standard monthly finance pack

- Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template

- Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records

- Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants

- Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.
Admin Support
Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

- Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork

- Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration

- Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities

- General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

- 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role

- Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations

- Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses

- Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes

- Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants

- Good written and spoken English

- Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies

- Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.
Working arrangement
This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.
The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.
Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Compensation
USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.
What success looks like
In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.
Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.
If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

This intelligent sensor and concierge service monitors a home’s electrical network to detect electrical hazards that often lead to the most devastating and catastrophic fires. While on the job preventing fires inside a home, Ting also helps monitor the electrical grid, contributing to increased community fire safety and reduced environmental impact that comes with fire reduction. We’re steadfastly addressing the long-underserved realm of electrical fire prevention with leading-edge technology and embarking on the next stage of our growth. Visit for more information.

About the Role

As an Administrative Clerk in a fully remote role, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the Fire Safety Team's (FST) operational efficiency and documentation integrity. Your main responsibilities will include activities associated with acquiring, reviewing, processing and paying contractor invoices and customer reimbursements associated with contractor visits that performed troubleshooting and mitigated electrical fire hazards for Ting customers. This work involves meticulously organizing, documenting, and digitally filing invoices from contractors/customers; updating related fields for accurate, timely reporting; and assisting with a variety of administrative tasks to support the team’s goals. This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and possesses a strong capability to multitask and prioritize work effectively in a virtual environment.

What You'll Do

- 
Invoice Management/Payment: Review, resolve issues, process, pay/request payment, file invoices and complete reporting associated with invoices received from contractors and customers requesting reimbursement (including proof of payment for reimbursements).

- 
Data Entry and Reporting: Update all necessary fields in the team's digital reporting systems to reflect current and accurate information. Assist in the preparation of reports and presentations summarizing financial and operational data for review by financial department and external departments. Perform error checking during work. Flag discrepancies and missing data for follow-up. Support efforts to maintain workflow to ensure timely payment to contractors and reimbursements to customers.

- 
Administrative Support: Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Fire Safety Team, managing email communications, and maintaining electronic filing systems. Serve as resource to investigate payment/invoicing issues for the FST. Track down missing invoices/proof of customer payment by contacting contractors and customers to get necessary documentation to complete processing. Reconcile and pay credit card transactions with contractor invoices. Ensure contractor visit reporting is complete and aligns with the work performed relative to the customer’s Ting credit balance and request payment by the Ting Labs Finance team if not able to be paid by credit card. Coordinate with Ting Labs Finance team to help ensure accurate and timely accounting of FST activities.

- 
Collaboration and Communication: Work closely within the FST, Ting Labs Finance team, external contractors and customers as needed to resolve any discrepancies in invoices or report documentation, maintaining clear and open lines of communication via phone, email, SMS/texting, chat and video conferencing to ensure all parties are informed of any changes or updates.

- 
Compliance and Best Practices: Adhere to all organizational policies and standard operating procedures ensuring that all work is completed. Actively contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for remote document management and administrative efficiency.

Requirements

Education: High school diploma or equivalent; further education or certification in administrative services, business administration, or a related field is a plus.

Experience: Proven experience as an administrative clerk, office assistant, or similar role, preferably with experience working remotely. Familiarity with document management, basic accounting practices and use of Excel spreadsheets, especially related to invoicing or financial documentation, is highly desirable. - Exceptional organizational and time-management abilities.

- Excellent data entry skills with high attention to detail.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable and experienced with all forms of communication tools to most efficiently complete the work and to get answers/problems resolved.

- Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), database software, and comfort with learning new digital tools and platforms.

- 
Characteristics: Adaptability to various digital working environments, problem-solving skills, integrity, confidentiality, and a high degree of self-motivation to work as part of a team focused on achieving goals to support our customers and company growth.

About Us
HireHawk connects experienced professionals with U.S. companies building high-performing remote teams. For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-based legal practice handling Personal Injury civil litigation, working closely with attorneys while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day litigation support.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced bilingual English-Spanish Civil Litigation Paralegal with hands-on California Personal Injury litigation experience. You will take substantial ownership of written discovery, communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients, prepare litigation documents, and help attorneys keep cases moving toward deadlines.
This is role is for someone who already understands how California civil litigation works in practice. You should be comfortable handling routine litigation matters independently, identifying what information is missing, following up proactively, and knowing when an issue requires attorney review.
The team values practical PI litigation knowledge, reliability, and work ethic more than having a minimal accent. Strong bilingual communication and the ability to get accurate information from clients matter most.
Responsibilities

- Own the preparation, organization, and coordination of written discovery for California Personal Injury litigation matters.

- Prepare and support responses to interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery requests.

- Communicate directly with English- and Spanish-speaking clients to gather case facts, records, documents, and other information required for discovery.

- Review client responses and supporting documents, identify missing or incomplete information, and follow up until discovery packages are ready for attorney review.

- Draft and prepare pleadings and other routine civil litigation documents with limited supervision.

- Coordinate with attorneys to ensure discovery responses, pleadings, and supporting materials are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

- Track California litigation deadlines, discovery due dates, court dates, and other case-related milestones.

- Prepare and coordinate California Superior Court filings and electronic filings.

- Organize medical records, supporting documents, client materials, and litigation files so attorneys can quickly access the information they need.

- Assist with motions and other litigation documentation when required while recognizing when attorney input or approval is necessary.

Requirements

Must-Have:

- Significant hands-on experience supporting U.S. Personal Injury civil litigation matters, including practical California litigation experience.

- Strong working knowledge of California civil discovery procedures, workflows, and deadlines.

- Demonstrated experience preparing interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery responses.

- Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, with the confidence to communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients about detailed case information.

- Strong legal drafting and document-review skills, including experience preparing pleadings and supporting litigation documents.

- Experience managing multiple active matters, competing deadlines, litigation calendars, and court filing requirements with a high degree of accuracy.

- Ability to independently handle routine civil litigation work, proactively resolve missing information, and appropriately escalate substantive legal questions to attorneys.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with California Superior Court electronic filing systems.

- Experience using MerusCase or comparable litigation case management software; MerusCase experience is strongly preferred.

- Paralegal certification or formal legal education.

- Previous experience working remotely with U.S. attorneys or litigation teams.

- Broader experience supporting motions and other pretrial litigation work.

- Make calls and send emails to suppliers, clients and service providers on the founder’s behalf

- Tracking his movements and getting a daily journal from him to enter his cost in 

- Keep documents up to clients on time 

Bookkeeping and finance

- Maintain the books in Xero, including bank reconciliations and coding transactions

- Prepare and send client invoices, including flat-fee charges for plant and equipment moves

- Prepare weekly payroll information ahead of the founder’s Wednesday pay run

- Keep supplier bills, receipts and records organised and up to date

- Keep in contact with employees if bills have no address or purchase order and make them accountable.

Job, plant and timesheet records

- Record plant and equipment movements between job sites as the founder’s reports them

- Maintain the NextMinute work management system by keeping records up to date, adding uncoded items, updating rates, fuel levies, and price increases, and allocating fuel costs to the appropriate machines.

- Log staff hours by job and site throughout the week

- Record material deliveries (e.g. tonnes of sand or gravel) against the right job and client

- Walk through the week's records with the founder each Wednesday to confirm everything is captured

Systems and process

- Write SOPs for each workflow you take on, building a playbook for the business as it scales

- Research and compare project management software for bookings, machinery and staff, run demos and present a recommendation

- Once chosen, set up and run the software in the background so the information stays accurate

- Support cost tracking on jobs as the business grows into larger projects

- Excel allocation and running cost so the director can see where costs are going and where they may be bleeding money 

- Scheduling and organizing machinery maintenance and registrations 

Requirements

- 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or Admin Assistant supporting a business owner

- Bookkeeping experience, ideally with Xero (reconciliations, invoicing, bills)

- Excellent spoken and written English, confident on the phone with Australian businesses

- Highly organised, with strong follow-through on deadlines and payments(hyper aggressive on late payments and keeping the owner himself accountable )

- Proactive and resourceful: you take a short instruction and run with it

Highly regarded:

- Experience in construction, civil, earthworks, trades or plant hire

- Familiarity with construction terms such as plant, tonnages, takeoffs and site deliveries

- Payroll and timesheet experience, including Australian payroll basics

- Experience with job management software such as NextMinute, ServiceM8, Buildxact, Tradify or similar

- Experience supporting Australian clients and working to AEST

Tools You’ll Use:
Xero, email and calendar (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), phone and SMS/WhatsApp, cloud file storage, and a project management platform once selected.

Attitude comes first. You're calm, reliable and switched on, and you enjoy bringing order to a busy, fast-moving business. FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote, LATAM
Job Type: Full-time
What you'll do
1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

- Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

- Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.
About RemotePro.ph

Summary
This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.
Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For
The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

- They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution 

- They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it 

- They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality 

- They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting 

- They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas 

- They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here
People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.
We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

- You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track 

- You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response 

- You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice 

- You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation 

- Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule 

- You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans 

- You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start 

- Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy 

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.
Responsibilities
You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.
That looks like:

- Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role

- Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention

- Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem

- Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination

- Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing

- Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current

- Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks

- Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

- At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role

- Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard

- Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role

- Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

- Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)

- Strong written English — emails are clear and professional before they're sent

- High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk

- Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

- Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent) 

- Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment 

- Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or Monday.com) 

- Basic bookkeeping or invoice processing experience (QuickBooks or Xero) 

- Experience with market research and competitor analysis

How We Work
We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.
There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.
We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.

scraped.title: Executive Assistant
scraped.description:
Executive Assistant – Irth Solutions
Job Type: Full-Time 
Location: Columbus, Ohio (Preferred); Open to Eastern and Central Time Zones 
Department: G&A
Reports To: VP, Talent Success in support of the Chief Commercial Officer primarily and the C-Suite executive
Company Overview
Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.
Position Summary
Irth Solutions is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and supplemental support to the CEO and other senior leaders.
Working closely with the existing Executive Assistant and broader administrative team, this individual will manage complex executive calendars, coordinate travel and events, track meeting agendas and action items, oversee day-to-day office operations, and develop scalable administrative processes.
The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, able to multitask, self-directed, flexible across leadership priorities, comfortable in a fast-changing, growing organization, and trusted with confidential information. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization and enjoys building efficient processes that support executive effectiveness.
This is a full-time position. While there is a preference for candidates within commuting distance of our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, we are considering all Eastern and Central time zone candidates.
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Support & Calendar Management

- Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the CCO and supplemental support for the rest of the C-Suite leaders, including but not limited to: scheduling and coordinating meetings, conferences, and calls with internal and external parties across time zones and functions.

- Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and adjustments to ensure optimal time management.

- Prepare meeting agendas and relevant documents for all appointments and events.

- Maintain and track executive agendas, ensuring all key meetings, deadlines, and deliverables are met.

- Provide reminders and follow up on action items from meetings and projects.

- Maintain files, records, and other documents for the executives, ensuring confidentiality and organization.

- Assist with presentations, reports, and other important documents as needed.

- Prioritize competing executive requests, exercising judgment on what should be moved, protected, delegated, or escalated.

- Flex across additional executives and shifting leadership priorities as the organization evolves.

2. Travel & Event Coordination

- Manage travel arrangements, accommodations, and itineraries, covering flights, lodging, ground transportation, and expense documentation.

- Coordinate logistics for internal and external events, including company meetings, conferences, webinars, and team-building activities.

- Ensure events run smoothly and efficiently, managing the setup, equipment, and supplies.

3. Process Improvement & Administrative Infrastructure

- Develop and maintain administrative processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation, including through AI tools.

- Create repeatable executive-support practices that can be shared across the team.

- Help establish scalable administrative infrastructure as Irth grows.

4. Office Operations & Employee Experience

- Oversee daily office operations, including office supplies, equipment maintenance, and vendor management.

- Maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.

- Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

- Coordinate logistics for office supplies, equipment, and materials.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:

- Ensure the CCO's calendar and schedule are organized, accurate, and aligned with business priorities.

- Provide reliable, proactive administrative support with minimal oversight.

- Help the CCO stay focused by anticipating needs and managing follow-through.

- Establish strong working relationships with the existing Executive Assistant and administrative team.

- Improve administrative workflows through documentation, consistency, and thoughtful use of technology.

- Ensure travel, meetings, events, and office operations are handled efficiently.

- Contribute to a scalable administrative support structure as Irth continues to grow.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite executives.

- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills.

- 3-5 years experience using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot or Claude.

- Ability to work on-site in Columbus, OH on a hybrid schedule; or if hired as remote employee, travel as needed to support executive team (less than 15% of the year)

- Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and prioritize competing executive requests.

- Flexibility to support additional executives and shifting leadership priorities.

- Comfort operating in a fast-changing, growing organization.

AI Use in Hiring
As part of our hiring process, Irth may use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools are intended to support the hiring process but do not replace human judgment or decision-making. All hiring decisions involve human review.
Role Type
This is a New Position. 
Compensation
The salary range for this role is USD $65,000-75,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.
Benefits
Why Join Irth?
At Irth, we believe great work happens when people have the support, flexibility, and resources they need to do their best work. As part of the Irth team, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

- The opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected within its industry.

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- A 401(k) plan with company match.

- Flexible PTO policy and company-paid holidays.

- Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, employee discounts, and perks programs.

- A generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.

- Opportunities to connect with colleagues through monthly company lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly team gatherings.

- Complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee for employees visiting our Columbus, Ohio office.

At Irth, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution, collaborate with a talented team, and grow alongside an evolving technology company.

scraped.description:
Rutter Mills LLP, a leading personal injury law firm in Hampton Roads, is seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal to support our trial attorneys throughout the litigation process. This remote position offers the opportunity to play a meaningful role in personal injury cases while collaborating with a respected team of legal professionals. 

Schedule: Full-time Monday through Friday

Location: Remote

About the Role:

As a Litigation Paralegal at Rutter Mills, you will work closely with attorneys, clients, and medical providers to manage personal injury cases from litigation through resolution, including trial, settlement, and escrow. This position requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage deadlines independently while maintaining consistent communication with your team.

The ideal candidate has experience with Virginia personal injury litigation, is comfortable working in a digital environment, and can manage a busy caseload remotely.

Key Responsibilities

- Draft, prepare, and file pleadings, motions, and discovery requests and responses.

- Manage case files, litigation calendars, and critical deadlines, including statutes of limitations.

- Review medical records and billing documentation, manage medical liens, and negotiate lien reductions as part of the case resolution process. 

- Coordinate depositions, mediations, settlements, and related case documentation.

- Support trial preparation, including exhibits, witness coordination, and courtroom logistics.

- Communicate professionally with clients, courts, medical providers, and opposing counsel.

- Ensure compliance with Virginia court rules, civil procedure, and e-filing requirements.

Qualifications

- 3+ years of personal injury litigation experience. General District Court and Circuit Court experience required.

- Strong working knowledge of Virginia court rules, civil procedure, and e-filing systems.

- Proven ability to manage caseloads with accuracy and organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience drafting legal documents, maintaining litigation files, and resolving or negotiating medical liens.

- Proficiency with case management systems, SmartAdvocate preferred.

- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with attorney and team members in a remote environment. 

Why Rutter Mills?

Rutter Mills LLP is a well-established and highly regarded personal injury firm with offices throughout Hampton Roads. Our litigation team is known for delivering exceptional results and providing compassionate client service.

We are also committed to giving back to the community through partnerships with local nonprofits and youth sports organizations, contributing time, resources, and support to the communities we proudly serve.

As our firm continues to grow, this role offers strong long-term career potential, including opportunities for advancement and increased responsibility within an expanding litigation team.

Benefits Include:

- Paid Time Off

- Health insurance

- 401(k) after 1 year

- Collaborative, team-oriented environment with experienced trial attorneys

Apply today to join a firm where your work directly impacts client outcomes and case success.

Staffing Agencies: Rutter Mills manages recruitment internally and does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions or recruiting services from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Please refrain from contacting our firm regarding open positions.

scraped.description:
About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role
Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.
You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

- Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

- Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

- Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

- Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

- Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

- Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

- Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

- Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

- Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

- Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

- Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

- Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

- Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

- Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

- Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

- Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

- Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

- Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

- Know Postgres and relational database practice.

- Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

- Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

- Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

- Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

- Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

- Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

- Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

- Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP
Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

- Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits
Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

scraped.description:
Location: 100% remote (Ohio residency required)
Classification: Full-time, exempt
Reports to: School Leader
Pay Range: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!
Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!
MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary
The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

- Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

- Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

- Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

- Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

- Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

- Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

- Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

- Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

- Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

- Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

- Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

- Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

- Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

- Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

- Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

- Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

- Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

- Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

- Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

- Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

- Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

- Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

- Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

- Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

- Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

- Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

- Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

- Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

- Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

- Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

- A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

- A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

- Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

- Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

- Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

- Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.

Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred

- Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements

- At least 3 years of teaching experience

- At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal

- Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online

- Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews

- Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems

The Ideal Candidate Brings:

- Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data

- Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school

Compensation & Benefits

- The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.
