- Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.

- All employees are eligible for a retirement plan with employer match.

- PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 200hours per year or 25 eight-hour days on average.

- Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 
We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 
The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

- Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Mandatory:

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

- Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

- Deep JavaScript and React.

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.
 
About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.
 
What you will do 
- Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
 
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
 
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
 
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
 
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
 
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
 
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
 
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for 
- A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
 
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
 
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
 
- Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
 
- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
 
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.
 
What the role offers 
- A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
 
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
 
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
 
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
 
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

scraped.description:
Payroll Specialist (Canada), Grand Forks, British Columbia 

Interfor is excited to invite you to join our dynamic Payroll team! If youâre ready to take the next step in your career, this is your chance to make an impact with us.

As a Payroll Specialist you will ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, primarily for Canadian employees in British Columbia, while complying with labour laws, employee handbooks, and collective bargaining agreements and managing data and time across the employee life cycle. The assigned portfolio for this role will be operations in BC, and the successful candidate may be embedded in one of our Southern Interior mill locations or based at our corporate office in Burnaby, BC.

Success in this role requires adaptability, integrity, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach.

What We Offer

The salary range for this role is $72,000 to $89,000 per year and is based on experience, skills, and qualifications. The total compensation package includes some of the following benefits:

- Group Benefit Programs (Employee Medical, Dental, Vision Plans) 

- RRSP Matching Plan 

- Participation in our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) 

- Participation in our Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP) 

- Paid Vacation 

- Employee Assistance Program 

Highlights of the Role

- Payroll Processing: Accurately manage full-cycle payroll for assigned companies/locations, including audits, reconciliations, and year-end tax forms. 

- Time & Attendance Management: Support the collection, validation, and reconciliation of time data, ensuring accuracy and alignment with payroll timelines. Partner with operations to resolve discrepancies and strengthen timekeeping controls. 

- Data Management: Handle employee life cycle data (hires, terminations, changes, leaves) and ensure seamless payroll integration. 

- Documentation & Compliance: Maintain SOPs, payroll tools, and ensure compliance with labour laws and privacy regulations. 

- Labour Relations & Field Partnership: Apply collective bargaining agreements, employee handbooks, and pay policies in practice, working directly with sites and union environments to resolve issues and ensure payroll reflects actual work performed. 

- Customer Service: Respond to employee pay inquiries and collaborate with HR and Finance to resolve payroll issues. 

- System & Process Improvement: Support payroll system maintenance, identify efficiency opportunities, participate in testing and contribute to system enhancements. 

- Team Collaboration: Foster a collaborative, accountable team environment, sharing knowledge and supporting peers to ensure consistent and accurate payroll delivery. 

What You Bring To The Role

- Experience: At least two years of full-cycle payroll experience with salaried and hourly employees; manufacturing experience is an asset; unionized experience required. 

- Education: Diploma or degree in accounting, payroll, or business administration, or equivalent experience. 

- Certifications: PCP or CPM certification is an asset but not mandatory. 

- Systems: Experience with payroll and time and attendance systems required; familiarity with ADP Workforce Now and UKGPro & Workforce Management preferred. 

Who We Are

At Interfor, our culture is built on integrity, respect, and collaboration. We believe in empowering employees, fostering career development, and operating sustainably to support both our people and our environment. Learn more at interfor.com.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. All applicants offered a position must successfully complete a pre-employment drug test and background check. Interfor is an Equal Opportunity Employer building a capable, committed, diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual identity, gender, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

scraped.title: Marketing Assistant
scraped.description:
Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.

The role
We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.

Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.

What you will do

- Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.

- Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.

- Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.

- Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.

- Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.

- General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.

What we are looking for

- Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience

- 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agencyÂ 

- Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline

- Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools

- Familiar with project management software

- A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased

- A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed

- Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup

- Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time

- Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig

Nice to have (not required)

- SEO or AI search visibility experience

- Experience with task managers like ClickUp

Who this is not for
This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.

What you get

- An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience.

- Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs

- Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay

- A long-term home, not a short-term contract

How to apply
Submit your resume and a short note about yourself, and answer this one question: what is one thing you would most want to get better at in this role, and why?

We read every application that answers it.

scraped.title: Data Analyst Assistant
scraped.description:
We are adding a Data Analyst Assistant to the team to support a large scale engagement with an established Italian infrastructure group. This position focuses on interrogating financial assumptions and identifying discrepancies in complex portfolios to ensure our partner makes decisions based on hard evidence rather than corporate narratives.
 
About Blue Oak Consulting
 Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional consulting firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped. We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism.
 
The Role
 This is a full time, permanent position that is conducted entirely in a remote environment. You will work closely with our principals to dig into the numbers provided by our partners, often starting with the Italian infrastructure project. The goal is to move past P&L complexity and find where value might be leaking. You will be expected to think critically and ask why certain numbers exist high up in a spreadsheet, rather than just accepting them as facts. This role offers an attractive and competitive compensation package for an entry level professional looking to gain deep experience in financial analysis.
 
What You Will Be Doing 
- Cleaning and organizing large datasets from various sources to build a clear financial picture.
 
- Testing the logic behind pricing assumptions to see if they survive real world friction.
 
- Helping build financial models that track capital allocation across different infrastructure assets.
 
- Identifying outliers and anomalies in expenditure reports that do not align with the stated narrative.
 
- Updating portfolio economics trackers to reflect new acquisition data.
 
- Collaborating with the team through virtual channels to clarify findings and refine analysis.
 
- Preparing clear summaries of data trends that highlight potential financial risks.
 
- Verifying the accuracy of inputs used in growth forecasts for specific business units.
 
- Assisting in the interrogation of acquisition assumptions for new investment opportunities.

What You Bring 
- A degree or background in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field with a heavy emphasis on data.
 
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manage complex formulas and large tables.
 
- A skeptical mindset that enjoys finding inconsistencies in spreadsheets and reports.
 
- Comfort working in a fully remote setting where communication is largely written and specific.
 
- Ability to organize messy data into structured formats without losing important context.
 
- Interest in how large businesses actually spend money and allocate internal capital.
 
- Reliability and a willingness to learn how to scrutinize financial statements at a deep level.
 
- Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing line items that seem out of place.

What We Offer 
- A fully remote work schedule that provides flexibility and removes the need for a daily commute.
 
- Direct access to firm principals who provide mentorship and clear feedback on your work.
 
- The opportunity to work on high stakes projects, such as our current work with the Italian infrastructure group.
 
- A professional environment focused on logic and evidence rather than corporate politics.
 
- Practical training in financial modeling and capital allocation analysis.
 
- A permanent, stable role within a firm that values individual accountability and results.

 At Blue Oak Consulting, we believe that clarity comes from discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase of our projects because we know that decisions looking sound in theory often face challenges once they meet reality. This role is a starting point for someone who wants to understand the mechanics of how value is created and protected in large organizations. We value the work over the performance, and we look for assistants who are eager to show how the numbers actually add up without relying on corporate jargon.

- Strong organizational and time management skills

Compensation

This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is based on a percentage of client monthly plans, with average monthly earnings ranging from $1,500-$3,800, depending on client mix.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates

- No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment

- Please always verify communications:
- Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address

- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links

- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts

We have Assistant Controller openings that would be a great fit for those coming from a private enterprise assurance group. Whether you want to eventually gain more public company financial reporting experience, or are looking to become a Controller in industry one day, this role is for you!

As Assistant Controller, responsibilities will include preparation of various working papers, oversight and review of full cycle accounting, and various other ad hoc projects unique to our respective clients. You will have ownership over specific client files, from a variety of industries including e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, mining and biotechnology.

At Treewalk, we offer significant flexibility (feel free to come into the office or work from home!) and a competitive benefits plan. This is a terrific opportunity for someone who loves working independently, has a strong desire to learn new things, and wants to grow professionally without necessarily working 60+ hours a week.

Who We Are

Treewalk (previously known as ACM Management) is an advisory practice based out of downtown Vancouver specializing in financial reporting and corporate services for public companies. We offer clients a complete service package to assist them in timely and accurate disclosures. Our clients are from all industry sectors and are issuers on the TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and the OTC.

We are one of the fastest growing accounting firms in Canada, and we've got some big goals that are going to send us to the top. We are a firm with an anti-firm culture - think tech startup, but accounting. We're ditching the traditional top-down management hierarchy approach and are leaning into a holacratic system of organizational governance. We are on a journey to become the go-to training place for accountants of all levels who want to work in industry. Our accounting practice specializes in assisting public companies with their financial reporting and accounting needs, and we help private companies navigate the waters of going and staying public. When it comes to clients, we are industry-agnostic. We never shy away from clients in new and emergent industries, and we've worked with companies in e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, mining, and biotechnology, to name a few. We've got a lot on the go, and as far as we're concerned, the only barrier to reaching our goals is finding exceptional talent to keep building out our team.

Our Core Values

Mastery: At Treewalk, we pursue knowledge. We aspire to be the best at our craft, and we create and pursue opportunities to build on our expertise.

Support: At Treewalk, you're never alone. Teamwork and collaboration are our bedrock, and constant support for each other and our clients is what sets us apart.

Ownership: At Treewalk, we fight to take responsibility. We own our mistakes and our oversights, and are relentlessly committed to our responsibility to our colleagues and our clients.

Kaizen: At Treewalk, we don't settle. Kaizen is a business philosophy that means "change for the better", or "continuous improvement". We recognize that nothing is perfect, but we're striving for it anyway.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

- Designated Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA)

- Assurance experience at a public accounting firm

- Relationship builder - maintains professional relationships with clients and team members alike with open and effective communication

- Take pride in making sure everything is correct; account balances that do not reconcile make you crazy. You find joy in solving that unsolvable problem;

- Are dedicated to the team and like to maintain a relaxed environment;

- Work well under the pressure of deadlines;

- Have an interest in a variety of work and being kept on your toes;

- Are technologically strong

- Have the ability to multitask and manage many different things at once;

- Love to make things better and challenge the status quo

- Are extremely detail-oriented and meticulous, even to the point where some might find it annoying;

Benefits

- We've got you covered from Day 1 - your extended healthcare and maternity leave benefits kick in on your first day of work!

Annual Salary - $86,000

We are the creators of the most viral journal in the world, The Five Minute Journal, a product that helped turn gratitude into a daily practice for millions of people globally. To date, Intelligent Change has sold over 4,000,000 products worldwide and built a deeply loyal, values-driven community.

Intelligent Change has been featured in The New York Times, Vogue, Forbes, ELLE, and other leading global publications. The New York Times described Intelligent Change as a brand that has "turned gratitude into a global movement."

The Role

This role reports directly to the Creative Director and sits at the heart of our creative team. You'll primarily design for social media and organic channels, bringing our products and ideas to life through engaging visual storytelling across Instagram, email, and digital campaigns.

You'll also collaborate closely with our Product Development team to design packaging, printed products, marketing materials, and launch assets that extend our brand across every customer touchpoint.

This is a role for someone who cares deeply about craft, typography, composition, photography, and the details that make great design feel effortless.

Remote Role

Candidates based in Toronto or Montreal will be given preference, as you'll occasionally join the Creative Director on set for campaign and content shoots.

Design Across Social

- Create high-quality designs for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Meta ads, email, and web

- Work closely with the Creative & Social teams to develop engaging social-first visuals that balance performance with strong brand design

- Design static posts, carousels, stories, reels covers, motion concepts, and campaign assets

Shape the Brand

- Contribute ideas for campaigns, launches, seasonal moments, and new creative directions

- Uphold a high bar for design quality and visual consistency

Design Physical Products

- Design supporting collateral including inserts, retail displays, presentations, and launch materials

- Prepare production-ready artwork for print

Collaborate Across Teams

- Work closely with the Creative Director to bring concepts from idea through execution

- Partner with marketing, product, copywriting, and operations teams to deliver cohesive campaigns

- Give and receive thoughtful creative feedback

Stay Curious

- Bring references, trends, ideas, and inspiration from fashion, publishing, interiors, wellness, and culture

- Continuously refine your craft and contribute fresh creative thinking to the team

Who You Are

Exceptional Visual Taste

You have a strong design point of view and a portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful typography, layout, composition, and attention to detail.

Social-First Designer

You understand what performs on modern social platforms without sacrificing quality or brand integrity. You know how to create content that feels native, engaging, and highly shareable.

Product Minded

You enjoy designing physical objects as much as digital ones. Packaging, books, journals, and printed materials excite you.

Curious and Collaborative

You enjoy working closely with writers, marketers, videographers, photographers, and product developers.

You communicate well, ask thoughtful questions, and care about making the work better.

Values Aligned

You have a genuine interest in mindfulness, personal growth, psychology, wellness, or intentional living. Our products resonate with you because you believe in what they help people achieve.

Detail Obsessed

You notice the spacing. The typography. The kerning. The print finish. The things most people overlook.

What We're Looking For

- Please note: Only candidates with submitted portfolios will be considered

- 2+ years of experience in graphic design or brand design

- Outstanding portfolio demonstrating strong visual taste

- Experience designing for social media

- Strong typography and editorial design skills

- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, Capcut

- Experience with AI such as Claude, Midjourney and other AI platforms

- Experience designing packaging or printed products is a significant advantage

Why This Role Matters

Design has always been at the heart of Intelligent Change.

Our products become part of people's homes, routines, and daily rituals. They are gifted, photographed, shared, and used for years.

Every Creative Decision Shapes How People Experience Our Brand.

As our Designer, you'll help define that experience, creating thoughtful work that reaches millions of people and inspires them to live more intentionally.

scraped.title: AI Testing Assistant
scraped.description:
Mosaic Conseil operates as a small, remote workshop dedicated to rebuilding one business artifact at a time. Whether it is a three year plan, a pricing grid, or a diligence file, we take things apart on the bench and put them back together against the evidence of the invoice ledger. The process is personal and focused. We do not work on standing retainers and we do not produce slide decks. Instead, we return the same artifact you sent, redrawn by hand and supported by a written argument. Our work is handled on paper and backed by a telephone number that answers for ninety days. We keep the workshop small on purpose to ensure that the people who do the work also answer their own phones. There are no meetings we did not schedule and no corporate theater. We focus on four specific rooms: financial services, industrial networks, growing software companies, and healthcare systems.
 
About Mosaic Conseil
 We are a boutique consultancy that values intellectual honesty and the discipline of a small, focused team. By staying small and fully remote, we remain independent and focused on the evidence at the floor of the business. Our clients come to us when they need a business plan or a financial model rebuilt with extreme precision. We provide a workspace where the primary goal is getting the numbers and the logic right, rather than making things look good in a presentation. Every file that leaves our workshop carries two names on the cover: one person who builds and one who argues against what was built. This ensures that every assumption is tested before a file closes. This environment is built for thinkers who prefer a written argument over a status meeting.
 
What you would do
 As an AI Testing Assistant, your work focuses on the intersection of business logic and automated analysis. You will be responsible for testing the outputs of AI models used to process financial and industrial data. This is an entry level role where you support our consultants by stress testing the artifacts we build. Your day to day work involves: 
- Reviewing AI generated summaries and data extractions for accuracy against original source documents like ledgers or contracts.
 
- Running standardized tests on internal AI tools to identify where they fail to grasp complex financial logic or industrial constraints.
 
- Building simple test cases to verify that a pricing model or a business plan remains consistent when variables are changed.
 
- Documenting specific instances of model error or hallucination in a clear, written format.
 
- Assisting the challenger in our builder and challenger model by providing evidence of where an automated calculation may have deviated from the truth.
 
- Comparing different AI model outputs to see which one handles specific industry terminology from healthcare or industrial networks more reliably.
 
- Verifying that the data used for a specific business artifact has been correctly mapped by our automated scripts.

Helpful background
 We are looking for individuals who have a natural curiosity about how technology works and, more importantly, how it breaks. This role is accessible to those starting their career or looking for part time work while finishing their studies. Helpful traits and experiences include: 
- Basic familiarity with Large Language Models and an understanding of how to prompt them for technical tasks.
 
- Competence in using spreadsheets like Excel or Google Sheets to verify calculations.
 
- Strong writing skills and the ability to explain a technical error in plain English.
 
- A background in business, finance, or computer science is useful but we value the ability to follow a logical argument above a specific degree.
 
- Technical comfort with remote work tools and a disciplined approach to managing your own schedule.
 
- Experience with personal projects or academic work that involves data analysis or AI testing.
 
- An interest in the specific sectors we serve, particularly financial services and industrial networks.

How we work
 Our workshop is entirely remote, meaning you can work from wherever you are most productive. We do not have an office and we do not hold meetings unless they are strictly necessary for the work. We communicate primarily through written documents and internal notes. Our builder and challenger model means that your work as a tester is central to our reputation. You are not just a support person: you are an essential part of the verification process that allows us to stand behind every artifact we produce. We prioritize deep work and give our team the quiet they need to find the errors that others miss. There is no requirement for residency in a specific city or country, as we operate a global, decentralized bench.
 
What the role offers
 This is a part time, contract position that is fully remote. You will have the opportunity to learn how high level business artifacts are constructed and how AI can be reliably integrated into professional services. The work is intellectually demanding and avoids the typical overhead of corporate life. We provide a space where you can focus on technical competence and analytical rigor. The position is paid and the pay is attractive for the role and the market, reflecting the care and attention to detail we expect from our testers. You will work directly with experienced professionals who answer their own phones and audit their own work, offering a direct view into the mechanics of boutique consultancy.
 Precision in our workshop is not a goal but a requirement. We believe that a business artifact is only as good as the evidence that supports it, and as an AI Testing Assistant, you are the one who ensures that evidence is sound. By looking for the cracks in the model before the client sees the work, you help us maintain a standard of intellectual honesty that is rare in modern consulting. Our process is slow by design, allowing for the kind of thoroughness that a faster, larger firm cannot provide.

scraped.description:
At Joko, we help consumers shop smarter. Our mission is to revolutionize shopping, empowering people to find what they need, make informed decisions, and save money.
Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 105 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.
From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts and carbon tracking, we keep expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Weâre now building an AI-powered shopping assistant to help users find the best products by price, quality, and environmental impact.
Having reached profitability in our core market, weâre now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

Itâs still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

ð§ Our Marketing team
No one is more creative and data-driven than this team; they truly combine the best of both worlds. The Marketing teamâs mission is to put our product into the hearts and hands of millions of users around the world.

- The Growth Team builds and scales innovative growth engines to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

- The Brand & Communications Team shapes Joko's long-term vision and builds a lasting emotional connection with users.

- The Campaign & Merchandising Team drives our B2C campaign calendar and elevates the shopping experience.

- The B2B Marketing Team positions Joko as the top partner in our space and builds a standout employer brand.

Led by Isa, our CMO, the team is constantly innovating to take the business to new heights.

ð¯ What you will do
As CRM & Lifecycle Manager, your mission is to design and run lifecycle programs that turn new signups into engaged, loyal, high-LTV Joko users. You will own the end-to-end CRM strategy across in-app, push, and email from the first onboarding message to the campaign that reactivates dormant users. You will join the Growth team, report to the VP Growth, and partner daily with Product, Data, and Brand teams.

Your main missions will be:

- Guide new users to their first Joko âwowâ moment: The first days shape everything that follows. Youâll design the onboarding journey: messaging, timing, and triggers so every new user feels understood and reaches activation quickly. At our scale, getting those first touches right compounds into millions of engaged users.

- Turn engaged users into power users, and power users into advocates: Youâll build retention and referral programs that deepen usage among our best users, drive word of mouth, and lift long-term retention.

- Maximize LTV across the full lifecycle: Youâll design cross-channel journeys that deliver the right benefit to the right user at the right moment. Youâll partner closely with Data to turn behavioral signals into segmentation and triggers, and with Product to keep lifecycle nudges tightly aligned with the in-app experience.

- Raise the bar on experimentation: Youâll run a continuous A/B testing program (hypotheses, tests, learnings, iterations) to improve existing flows and challenge our current lifecycle map. Every decision should be grounded in evidence, not intuition.

- Take CRM to the next level with AI: Youâll use AI to automate the operational grind (segmentation, copy iteration, QA, reporting) and unlock what we couldnât run manually: sharper personalization, faster experimentation cycles, and richer lifecycle logic. Youâll decide where AI genuinely moves the needle (and where it doesnât), then ship production solutions.

- Drive growth across the company: Youâll work hand-in-hand with Product, Data, User Acquisition, and Brand so CRM compounds alongside everything else weâre building.

ð Who we're looking for

- Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in B2C CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a high-growth mobile or consumer app. Youâve owned lifecycle programs end-to-end, not just executed individual components.

- CRM craft: Youâre hands-on with modern CRM platforms (Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or similar) and you know what âgoodâ looks like across in-app, push, and email. Deliverability, segmentation logic, template design, and orchestration are second nature.

- Data-driven to the core: You read cohort curves, funnel data, and A/B test results fluently. You use data to form opinions and drive decisions, not just to build reports.

- Experimentation mindset: Youâve run structured A/B testing programs and know how to design experiments that actually teach you something, not just optimize a subject line.

- Curious and hands-on with AI: Youâre genuinely excited by what AI can do for CRM. Youâve already built solutions from scratch using AI to improve workflows or drive impact, and you have real opinions formed from real attempts on where it works and where it doesnât.

- User-centric: Youâre relentlessly curious about how users think, what they need, and how they respond. Every message you ship starts from a real user insight, not a template.

- Ownership and drive: You take initiative, hold yourself accountable to outcomes (not activities), and move fast without dropping the ball.

- Attention to detail: You know a broken merge tag, a mistimed push, or a poorly segmented email can undo weeks of work. You have a talent for spotting flaws before they ship.

- Languages: Youâre a native-level French speaker and fluent in English, our internal working language.

ð Our perks
(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)
At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

- Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

- Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

- ð¸ Top-market compensation

- ð Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

- ð¤ Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

- ð´ Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

- ðª Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

- ð¼ 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

- â¦and much more, check the full list here!

ð¤ Our hiring process

- Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

- Step 1 â Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team youâd join, or colleagues from other teams).

- Step 2 â Role-specific assessments

- For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

- For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

- Step 3 â Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

- References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

â You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

About Valiantys
Valiantys is a global professional services firm dedicated to helping engineering and service organizations transform how they work, using AI-enabled software delivery, modern ITSM, and platform engineering.

The opportunity
We're hiring a Chief of Staff to support the CEO. This role exists to increase the CEO's leverage, strengthen executive alignment, and improve the quality and pace of key decisions. It is not a substitute for operating leadership and does not own day-to-day company operations. Instead, the Chief of Staff acts as an extension of the CEO to drive clarity, follow-through, and executive coherence across the leadership team.

Location: This role can be located in the United States, (EST, New York City preferred). We offer flexible remote working policy.

What You'll Own
Operating cadence
Design and run the executive operating rhythm across a distributed leadership team. This includes C-suite meeting design, leadership team offsites, and the CEO's 1:1 cadence - ensuring each forum has a clear purpose, the right participants, the right pre-work, and concrete outputs.

Decision governance
Build and maintain the decision-making infrastructure for the exec team: RACI frameworks, decision logs, real-time commitment tracking. Make the implicit explicit. Document decisions as they're made, track what was decided, by whom, and what happens next.

Strategic progress tracking
Create the scorecards, dashboards, and executive reporting rhythms that give the CEO clear visibility into transformation priorities, business risks, and decisions requiring intervention. Partner closely with the COO and executive team to synthesize progress, surface slippage early, and sharpen the quality of discussion at the top. This role owns executive-level transparency and escalation.

Executive forum quality
Own the output quality of the company's most important executive forums. This means ensuring the right pre-reads exist, decisions are captured in real time, follow-through is tracked, and unresolved issues are escalated quickly. The standard is that every significant forum produces clarity, accountability, and momentum.

Executive communications
Craft the materials that shape the company's most important conversations: board updates, executive memos, decision briefs, CEO communications, investor-ready narratives, and sensitive internal messaging. Turn complex issues into crisp, well-structured communication tailored to senior audiences. Ensure the CEO enters key discussions with sharp materials, clear points of view, and decision-ready framing.

Thought partnership
Serve as a trusted sounding board to the CEO on strategic priorities, sensitive issues, and cross-functional tradeoffs. Translate complex discussions into structured options, clear decisions, and actionable next steps. Where appropriate, represent the CEO in selected forums with clearly defined delegated authority and return with sharp recommendations or follow-up actions.

How Youâll Drive Impact
The Chief of Staff focuses on sharpening priorities, improving executive decision-making, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and ensuring follow-through on the issues that matter most.

You will partner closely with the COO and leadership team to ensure the c-suite has clear visibility into execution, risks, dependencies, and decisions that require intervention.

You will operate across distributed, multi-regional leadership teams (US, Europe, APAC). You understand the asynchronous communication patterns, the coordination costs, and the discipline required to keep a globally distributed exec team aligned.

Success in the role comes from creating leverage, clarity, and momentum across the executive team.

What We're Looking For

- A proven operator who has built executive operating rhythm in a 300 to 600 person professional services or B2B services business and knows what well-run looks like

- Fluency in driving accountability through influence: building trust with senior leaders, holding peers accountable as a partner, and earning a mandate rather than asserting one

- The ability to hold the full operating plan, see dependencies, and anticipate second-order effects before they surface as problems

- Structured thinking that turns complexity and conflicting inputs into clear options and decisions

- Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information and competing priorities, and a clear sense of when to push, escalate, or stay behind the scenes

Qualifications

- 8-12 years of experience, including 2+ years in a Chief of Staff, Executive Strategy & Operations, GM, or equivalent operating role

- MBA or equivalent; strategy consulting background a plus, not a requirement

- A proven record of designing and building operating infrastructure for a distributed executive teams

- Professional services, consulting, or B2B services background strongly preferred, , with a working understanding of the economics and the consultative model

- Meaningful experience in transformation contexts: strategic pivot, M&A integration, or major operational change

- PE-backed or high-growth experience, board exposure, and strong executive writing are each a plus

What Success Looks Like

- The CEO is spending more time on the highest-value strategic priorities and less time on coordination overhead

- The COO has more capacity to scale the business and lead day-to-day operations

- Executive forums produce clearer decisions, better follow-through, and faster escalation of critical issues

- Cross-functional priorities are visible, coordinated, and less dependent on the CEO personally chasing progress

- Board and investor discussions are supported by more consistent, decision-ready materials and reporting

If this is you
This role suits an operator who builds the rhythm a leadership team runs on and leads through relationships rather than authority. You want to build something that matters, operate at pace inside a high-stakes transformation, and have a direct line to impact with visibility into the highest levels of decision-making.

Our team members are our greatest asset and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.

Sense. We're committed to giving you the level of information you need to make sense of your assignments. You will witness the impact of your actions.

Training. We will provide you with the necessary time and budget to help you develop your skills and continue to build your career.

Flexibility. We understand that life is all about balance and we offer you the flexibility and support to help you maintain balance across the different pillars of your life.

- A flexible remote work policy

- A multicultural and international team environment

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

scraped.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
scraped.description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as Supabase continues to scale globally. This person will be a trusted partner to the CEO, helping manage time, communication, priorities, travel, follow-through, and key operating rhythms across a fast-moving, remote-first company.

This role must be based in an APJ / APAC timezone to provide strong timezone coverage for our CEO and leadership team. You’ll work closely with founders, executives, internal stakeholders, investors, and external partners, ensuring the CEO is prepared, focused, and able to spend time on the highest-impact work.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, has strong judgment, and is excited about supporting a developer-focused company building tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

In this role, you’ll:

- 
Own the CEO’s calendar management, prioritization, and day-to-day operating rhythm.

- 
Manage inbox triage and communications by monitoring emails, drafting responses, and keeping communication flowing across internal and external stakeholders.

- 
Prepare briefings, agendas, decks, notes, and follow-up materials so the CEO is ready for every meeting.

- 
Track follow-ups, decisions, and commitments to help projects move forward and keep stakeholders accountable.

- 
Coordinate seamless domestic and international travel, logistics, scheduling changes, and last-minute adjustments.

- 
Support investor meetings, board-related preparation, executive meetings, offsites, and company-wide moments.

- 
Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion, professionalism, and integrity.

- 
Anticipate needs, identify blockers early, and solve problems proactively before they escalate.

- 
Partner across the company to create clarity, improve coordination, and help leadership operate effectively in a global, remote-first environment.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- 
Have experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in a startup or scale-up environment.

- 
Are based in an APJ / APAC timezone and can provide strong coverage for a globally distributed leadership team.

- 
Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, with excellent written and verbal communication.

- 
Have experience working in async, remote-first, or globally distributed teams.

- 
Are tech savvy and comfortable using tools like Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, and AI-enabled workflows.

- 
Bring strong judgment around prioritization, confidentiality, stakeholder management, and executive communication.

- 
Are energized by organized chaos, fast-moving priorities, and solving problems before they become blockers.

- 
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and staying several steps ahead.

What We Offer

- 
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

scraped.description:
We are currently seeking an Administrative Officer / Legal Administrative Officer to provide mid to long term support to our financial service client: 
Responsibilities:

- Provide day-to-day administrative support and assist in fundraising activities, including preparing materials and coordinating with investors

- Support funds and simple investment transactions, including related documentation and operational tasks

- Handle some NDAs, confidential agreements, and other legal/transaction documents (from templates), including tracking and filing

- Perform basic company secretarial work, such as simple share transfer forms and straightforward board resolutions 

Requirements

- Degree holder with legal related background

- 0-3 years of work experience; applicants who are new to workforce are also welcome

- Strong attention to detail, high level of accuracy, and strong organizational skills

- Awareness in handling confidential information; comfortable working on large amount of administrative tasks

- Fluent English and able to read and write Chinese. Fluency in spoken Mandarin is a bonus, but not essential

- Immediately available is preferred

Compensation, Benefits & Working Location: 
This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, CPF/MPF contributions and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiom provides the opportunity to work remotely, onsite or hybrid, depending on client requirements.
Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services.
Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation.
Learn more about life at Axiom.
World-class clients – our global presence provides direct access to opportunities with leading companies, including F100 organizations, allowing you to roadmap your career with exciting and challenging work.
